title: DeepSlide: From Artifacts to Presentation Delivery
summary: Presentations are a primary medium for scholarly communication, yet most AI slide generators optimize the artifact (a visually plausible deck) while under-optimizing the delivery process (pacing, narrative, and presentation preparation). We present DeepSlide, a human-in-the-loop multi-agent system that supports preparing the full presentation process, from requirement elicitation and time-budgeted narrative planning, to evidence-grounded slide--script generation, attention augmentation, and rehearsal support. DeepSlide integrates (i) a controllable logical-chain planner with per-node time budgets, (ii) a lightweight content-tree retriever for grounding, (iii) Markov-style sequential rendering with style inheritance, and (iv) sandboxed execution with minimal repair to ensure renderability. We further introduce a dual-scoreboard benchmark that cleanly separates static artifact quality from dynamic delivery excellence. Across 20 domains and diverse audience profiles, DeepSlide matches strong baselines on artifact quality while consistently achieving larger gains on delivery metrics, improving narrative flow, pacing precision, and slide--script synergy with clearer attention guidance.

AI.tldr: DeepSlide是一个人类参与的多元智能系统，用于支持完整的演示文稿准备过程，从需求获取、时间预算叙事规划，到基于证据的幻灯片-脚本生成、注意力增强和排练支持。它在保持静态文稿质量的同时，显著提升了动态交付指标（叙事流畅性、节奏精度、幻灯片-脚本协同和注意力引导）。
AI.motivation: 现有AI幻灯片生成器主要优化视觉文稿本身，而忽略了交付过程（节奏、叙事和演示准备），导致生成的幻灯片在实际演讲中效果不佳。
AI.method: 提出DeepSlide系统，包含：(i) 可控逻辑链规划器（含每节点时间预算），(ii) 轻量级内容树检索器用于证据支撑，(iii) 马尔可夫式顺序渲染与风格继承，(iv) 沙盒执行与最小修复确保可渲染性。并引入双记分牌基准，分离静态质量与动态交付质量。
AI.result: 在20个领域和多样化受众画像中，DeepSlide在文稿质量上与强基线持平，同时在交付指标上持续取得更大增益，包括叙事流畅性、节奏精度、幻灯片-脚本协同和注意力引导清晰度。
AI.conclusion: AI辅助演示生成应同时优化最终文稿质量和演讲交付过程，DeepSlide证明了兼顾两者的可行性和有效性。

title: SDOF: Taming the Alignment Tax in Multi-Agent Orchestration with State-Constrained Dispatch
summary: Multi-agent orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, and CrewAI route tasks through graph-based pipelines but do not enforce the stage constraints that govern real business processes. We present SDOF, a framework that treats multi-agent execution as a constrained state machine. SDOF operates through two primary defensive layers, implemented by three components: (1) an Online-RLHF Specialized Intent Router trained via Generative Reward Modeling (GRPO) and (2) a StateAwareDispatcher with GoalStage finite-automaton checks and precondition/postcondition SkillRegistry validation for auditable execution control. On a recruitment system backed by the Beisen iTalent platform (6000+ enterprises), 185 expert-curated scenarios trigger 1671 live API calls. Our GSPO-aligned 7B Intent Router achieves higher joint accuracy than zero-shot GPT-4o on this FSM-constrained adversarial routing benchmark (80.9% versus 48.9%). In end-to-end execution, SDOF reaches 86.5% task completion (95% confidence interval 80.8 to 90.7) and blocks all 22 operations in the injection, illegal HR subset. Under a broader message-level blocking audit, SDOF attains precision 100% and recall 88%, expert agreement kappa=0.94. A separate evaluation on 960 SGD-derived dialogues spanning 8 service domains surfaces 201 stage-order conflicts under our FSM mapping, 41 of which arise in the normal split. This arXiv version reports the current validated scope; extended multi-seed training comparisons and deeper workflow evaluations will be released in a subsequent update.

AI.tldr: SDOF是一个将多智能体执行转化为约束状态机的框架，通过在线RLHF意图路由器和状态感知调度器实现安全的业务流程控制，在招聘系统中达到86.5%任务完成率和100%的注入攻击拦截精度。
AI.motivation: 现有的多智能体编排框架（如LangChain、LangGraph、CrewAI）通过图结构流水线路由任务，但未能强制执行真实业务流程中的阶段约束，导致安全性和合规性不足。
AI.method: SDOF将多智能体执行建模为约束状态机，包含两个防御层：(1) 基于在线RLHF的专用意图路由器，使用生成式奖励建模（GRPO）训练；(2) StateAwareDispatcher，包含GoalStage有限自动机检查和前提条件/后置条件SkillRegistry验证。
AI.result: 在基于北森iTalent平台的招聘系统中，7B意图路由器在FSM约束对抗路由基准上联合准确率80.9%（GPT-4o为48.9%）；端到端任务完成率86.5%；拦截全部22个注入和非法HR操作；消息级拦截精度100%、召回88%，专家一致性kappa=0.94。
AI.conclusion: SDOF通过状态机约束有效增强了多智能体系统的安全性和合规性，验证了在真实企业级场景中的可行性。

title: Does Theory of Mind Improvement Really Benefit Human-AI Interactions? Empirical Findings from Interactive Evaluations
summary: Improving the Theory of Mind (ToM) capability of Large Language Models (LLMs) is crucial for effective social interactions between these AI models and humans. However, the existing benchmarks often measure ToM capability improvement through story-reading, multiple-choice questions from a third-person perspective, while ignoring the first-person, dynamic, and open-ended nature of human-AI (HAI) interactions. To directly examine how ToM improvement techniques benefit HAI interactions, we first proposed the new paradigm of interactive ToM evaluation with both perspective and metric shifts. Next, following the paradigm, we conducted a systematic study of four representative ToM enhancement techniques using both four real-world datasets and a user study, covering both goal-oriented tasks (e.g., coding, math) and experience-oriented tasks (e.g., counseling). Our findings reveal that improvements on static benchmarks do not always translate to better performance in dynamic HAI interactions. This paper offers critical insights into ToM evaluation, showing the necessity of interaction-based assessments in developing next-generation, socially aware LLMs for HAI symbiosis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的交互式心理理论（ToM）评估范式，发现传统静态基准测试的提升并不总能转化为动态人机交互中的更好表现，强调了基于交互评估的必要性。
AI.motivation: 现有ToM基准测试通常通过第三人称的故事阅读和选择题来评估，忽略了人机交互中第一人称、动态和开放式的特性，无法真实反映ToM改进技术对HAI交互的实际效果。
AI.method: 1. 提出交互式ToM评估新范式，包含视角转换（第一人称）和度量转换（动态交互表现）；2. 对四种代表性ToM增强技术进行系统研究；3. 使用四个真实世界数据集并开展用户研究；4. 覆盖目标导向（编程、数学）和体验导向（咨询）两类任务。
AI.result: 静态基准上的改进并不总能转化为动态HAI交互中更好的表现。
AI.conclusion: 基于交互的评估对于开发下一代具有社会感知能力的LLM以实现人机共生至关重要。
idea_en: A dynamic, first-person interactive evaluation paradigm for Theory of Mind in LLMs, shifting from static third-person benchmarks to real-time social interaction assessment.
A dual-axis evaluation framework incorporating both perspective shift (first-person vs. third-person) and metric shift (static vs. dynamic interaction metrics) for ToM assessment.
A systematic comparative methodology for evaluating ToM enhancement techniques across both goal-oriented (coding, math) and experience-oriented (counseling) HAI tasks.
An interaction-based ToM assessment system that measures whether static benchmark improvements actually translate to real-world HAI interaction quality.
idea_ch: 一种面向LLM心理理论的动态第一人称交互评估范式，将评估从静态第三人称基准转向实时社交互动表现评估。

一种基于交互的ToM评估系统，用于检测静态基准改进是否能真正转化为真实HAI交互质量的提升。

title: SkillSmith: Compiling Agent Skills into Boundary-Guided Runtime Interfaces
summary: Recently, skills have been widely adopted in large language model (LLM)-based agent systems across various domains. In existing frameworks, skills are typically injected into the agent reasoning loop as contextual guidance once matched to a runtime task, enabling specialized task-solving capabilities. We find that this execution paradigm introduces two major sources of redundancy: irrelevant context injection and repeated skill-specific reasoning and planning. To this end, we propose SkillSmith, a boundary-first compiler-runtime framework that compiles skill packages offline into minimal executable interfaces. By extracting fine-grained operational boundaries from skills, SkillSmith enables agents to dynamically access and execute only the relevant components at runtime, thereby minimizing unnecessary context injection and redundant reasoning overhead. In the evaluation on SkillsBench benchmark, SkillSmith reduces solve-stage token usage by 57.44%, thinking iterations by 42.99%, solve time by 50.57% (2.02x faster), and token-proportional monetary cost by 57.44% compared with using raw-skills. Moreover, compiled artifacts produced by a stronger model can be reused by a smaller or more efficient runtime model, improving task accuracy in cases where raw skill interpretation fails. The source code and data are available at https://github.com/AetherHeart-AI/Aeloon.

AI.tldr: SkillSmith提出一种边界优先的编译器-运行时框架，通过将技能包离线编译为最小可执行接口，减少LLM代理系统中无关上下文注入和重复推理的开销，在SkillsBench上实现57.44%的token节省和2.02倍加速。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM代理系统中，技能通常以完整上下文形式注入推理循环，导致两大冗余：1) 注入大量与当前任务无关的上下文信息；2) 代理在每个任务中重复进行技能特定的推理和规划，造成计算资源浪费。
AI.method: 提出SkillSmith框架，包含编译器阶段和运行时阶段。编译器阶段离线将技能包编译为最小可执行接口，提取细粒度的操作边界（operational boundaries）；运行时阶段代理仅动态访问和执行与当前任务相关的技能组件，减少不必要的上下文注入和推理开销。
AI.result: 在SkillsBench基准上，相比原始技能方案，解决阶段token使用减少57.44%，思考迭代减少42.99%，解决时间减少50.57%（2.02倍加速），按token计费的成本降低57.44%。且强模型编译出的工件可被小模型或高效模型复用，在原始技能解释失败时提升任务准确率。
AI.conclusion: SkillSmith通过边界优先的编译-运行时解耦设计，有效提升了LLM代理系统的执行效率和经济性，同时实现了跨模型的知识复用。
idea_en: A boundary-first compiler-runtime framework (SkillSmith) for LLM-based agent systems that compiles skill packages offline into minimal executable interfaces, enabling agents to dynamically access and execute only relevant components at runtime.
A method for extracting fine-grained operational boundaries from skill packages to minimize irrelevant context injection and redundant reasoning overhead in agent systems.
A cross-model skill compilation reuse mechanism where compiled artifacts produced by a stronger LLM can be directly utilized by a smaller or more efficient runtime model, improving task accuracy.
An agent execution paradigm that decouples skill compilation (offline) from skill execution (runtime) to reduce solve-stage token usage, thinking iterations, and monetary cost.
idea_ch: 一种边界优先的编译器-运行时框架（SkillSmith），将LLM代理系统的技能包离线编译为最小可执行接口，运行时仅动态访问和执行相关组件

title: Fair outputs, Biased Internals: Causal Potency and Asymmetry of Latent Bias in LLMs for High-Stakes Decisions
summary: Instruction-tuned language models exhibit behavioural fairness in high-stakes decisions while retaining biased associations in their internal representations. However, whether these suppressed representations can affect model outputs - and whether such causal potency is symmetric across demographic groups - remains unknown. We investigate the use of open-weight models for mortgage underwriting using matched applications that differ only in racially-associated names and reveal a critical disconnect: models show no output-level bias, yet retain and amplify demographic representations across model layers. Through activation steering and novel cross-layer interventions, we demonstrate that this suppressed information is decision-relevant: when reinjected at critical layers, it produces near-complete decision reversals. Critically, this latent bias is asymmetric - steering interventions affect decisions in one demographic direction, while producing minimal effects in reverse - and susceptible to adversarial prompt engineering and parameter-efficient fine-tuning. These findings demonstrate that behavioural audits focused on outputs are insufficient: fair outputs can mask exploitable internal biases. They also motivate dual-layer testing frameworks combining output evaluation with representational analysis for AI governance in high-stakes decisions.

AI.tldr: 指令微调的语言模型在高风险决策中展现出行为层面的公平性，但内部表征仍保留有偏关联。通过激活引导和跨层干预实验发现，这些被抑制的偏见表征具有决策相关性，且具有不对称性，可以通过对抗性提示和参数高效微调被利用。
AI.motivation: 探究指令微调语言模型中被抑制的内部偏见表征是否仍然可以影响模型输出，以及这种因果效力在不同人口群体之间是否对称。
AI.method: 使用开放权重模型进行抵押贷款承销任务，利用仅种族关联姓名不同的匹配申请；通过激活引导和新型跨层干预技术，在关键层重新注入被抑制的人口统计信息，观察决策反转效果。
AI.result: 模型在输出层面未表现出偏见，但内部表征保留并放大了人口统计信息；重新注入这些信息可在关键层产生近乎完全的决策反转；潜在偏见是不对称的，且可被对抗性提示工程和参数高效微调利用。
AI.conclusion: 仅关注输出层面的行为审计不足以检测模型中的可被利用的内部偏见，需要结合输出评估与表征分析的“双层测试框架”来加强AI治理。
idea_en: A cross-layer activation steering method for detecting and measuring suppressed demographic biases in instruction-tuned language models by reinjecting latent representations at critical transformer layers.
An asymmetric bias detection framework that identifies demographic-group-specific causal potency differences in language model internal representations.
A dual-layer AI governance testing framework combining output-level behavioral evaluation with internal representation analysis for high-stakes decision-making systems.
A matched-application testing methodology using racially-associated name variations to isolate demographic bias in model internal representations while controlling for other factors.
An adversarial prompt engineering technique designed to exploit suppressed demographic representations in instruction-tuned language models.
idea_ch: 一种跨层激活引导方法，通过在关键Transformer层重新注入潜在表征，检测和测量指令微调语言模型中被抑制的人口统计偏见。
一种非对称偏见检测框架，用于识别语言模型内部表征中不同人口群体特有的因果效力差异。
一种双层AI治理测试框架，结合输出层面的行为评估与内部表征分析，适用于高风险决策系统。
一种匹配申请测试方法，利用仅种族关联姓名不同的申请变体，在控制其他因素的同时隔离模型内部表征中的人口统计偏见。
一种对抗性提示工程技术，用于利用指令微调语言模型中被抑制的人口统计表征。

title: CAX-Agent: A Lightweight Agent Harness for Reliable APDL Automation
summary: Large language models deployed for MAPDL finite-element simulation face practical reliability challenges: without structured execution control, tool encapsulation, and fault recovery, outputs may be inconsistent and task failures are common. The Agent Harness paradigm addresses this by inserting domain-specific orchestration middleware that manages tool lifecycles, workflow state, and recovery escalation. This paper presents the architecture of CAX-Agent, a lightweight agent harness purpose-built for MAPDL automation, and empirically evaluates one of its core components -- the recovery policy.CAX-Agent organizes execution into three layers -- LLM service, agent harness, and solver backend -- with a recovery ladder that escalates from deterministic rule patching through model-driven regeneration to context enrichment and human intervention. We evaluate three recovery strategies (no_recovery, rule_only, and model_only) on 50 standard structural benchmarks with three repeated runs per strategy (450 case-runs total). Two independent human raters score task completion under blind conditions; inter-rater agreement is strong (quadratic weighted Cohen's kappa = 0.84, 96 percent of score pairs within one point). Model_only achieves the best completion rate (0.9267), task score (3.59/4), total score (9.16/10), and zero-intervention rate (0.84), outperforming rule_only (0.7733, 3.17/4, 7.03/10, 0.00) and no_recovery (0.6933, 2.74/4, 5.60/10, 0.00) with large effect sizes (Cliff's delta = 0.81-0.87). The benchmark uses deliberately simple geometries to isolate recovery-policy effects; we discuss the scope of these findings and directions for broader validation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了CAX-Agent——一个专为MAPDL有限元仿真设计的轻量级代理框架，通过三层架构（LLM服务、代理枢纽、求解器后端）和恢复阶梯策略解决大语言模型在工程仿真中的可靠性问题。实验表明，基于模型驱动的恢复策略在任务完成率(0.9267)、评分(3.59/4)和零干预率(0.84)上显著优于无恢复和仅规则策略。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在MAPDL有限元仿真中面临实践可靠性挑战：缺乏结构化执行控制、工具封装和故障恢复机制，导致输出不一致、任务频繁失败。
AI.method: 提出CAX-Agent代理框架，采用三层架构（LLM服务层、代理枢纽层、求解器后端层），核心创新是恢复阶梯策略——从确定性规则修补、模型驱动再生、上下文丰富化到人工干预的逐级升级机制。实验对比了无恢复、仅规则恢复和仅模型恢复三种策略。
AI.conclusion: 模型驱动的恢复策略在MAPDL仿真任务中显著优于规则驱动和无恢复策略，但当前基准使用简单几何以隔离恢复策略影响，未来需在复杂场景中进一步验证。
idea_en: A multi-layer agent harness architecture (LLM service layer, orchestration middleware layer, solver backend layer) for domain-specific finite-element simulation, where the middleware layer manages tool lifecycles, workflow state, and recovery escalation.

A recovery ladder escalation mechanism for LLM-driven engineering simulation, comprising four levels: deterministic rule patching, model-driven regeneration, context enrichment, and human intervention, with automatic escalation between levels.

A lightweight agent harness (CAX-Agent) specifically designed for MAPDL (ANSYS Parametric Design Language) automation, enabling structured execution control and tool encapsulation for LLM-based finite element analysis.
A model-driven recovery strategy for LLM failures in simulation tasks that outperforms rule-only and no-recovery approaches, achieving 0.84 zero-intervention rate in structural benchmark tests.
idea_ch: 一种用于领域特定有限元仿真的多层代理框架架构（LLM服务层、编排中间件层、求解器后端层），其中中间件层负责管理工具生命周期、工作流状态和故障恢复升级。
一种面向LLM驱动工程仿真的恢复阶梯升级机制，包含四个层级：确定性规则修补、模型驱动再生、上下文丰富化和人工干预，支持层级间自动升级。

title: NOVA: Fundamental Limits of Knowledge Discovery Through AI
summary: Can AI systems discover genuinely new knowledge through iterative self improvement, and if so, at what cost? We introduce the NOVA framework, which models the common ``generate, verify, accumulate, retrain'' loop as an adaptive sampling process over a knowledge space. We identify sufficient conditions under which accumulated genuine knowledge eventually covers a finite domain, and show how their violations produce distinct failure modes: contamination, forgetting, exploration failure, and acceptance failure. We then analyze imperfect verification and identify a contamination trap: as easy-to-find knowledge is exhausted, the model mass assigned to new valid artifacts shrinks, so even small false-positive rates can cause invalid artifacts to enter the knowledge base faster than genuine discoveries. We clarify that Good--Turing estimation is a local batch-diversity diagnostic, not an estimator of the historically undiscovered valid mass that governs long-term discovery. Under a separate tail-equivalence assumption relating the model's effective discovery distribution to a Zipf law with exponent $α>1$, we prove that the cumulative generation cost required to obtain $D$ distinct genuine discoveries satisfies $R_{\mathrm{cum}}(D)=Θ(c_{\mathrm{gen}}D^α)$, where $c_{\mathrm{gen}}$ is the per-candidate generation cost. This scaling law quantifies asymptotic diminishing returns as the discovery frontier advances. Finally, we formalize human amplification through guidance, generation, and verification, explaining why expert input is most valuable near autonomous exploration barriers.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了NOVA框架，将常见的"生成-验证-积累-再训练"循环建模为知识空间上的自适应采样过程，分析了AI系统通过迭代自我改进发现新知识的条件、失败模式以及成本扩展规律。
AI.motivation: 探究AI系统能否通过迭代自我改进真正发现新知识，以及这种发现过程需要付出怎样的代价。
AI.method: 提出NOVA框架，将AI自我改进循环建模为知识空间上的自适应采样过程；识别知识覆盖有限域的充分条件；分析验证不完美导致的污染陷阱；利用尾等价假设（Zipf定律）推导发现成本的标度律。
AI.result: 发现四种失败模式：污染、遗忘、探索失败和接受失败；证明了污染陷阱的存在；推导出累积生成成本与发现数量的标度律关系R_cum(D)=Θ(c_genD^α)；形式化了人类放大效应。
AI.conclusion: AI系统通过迭代自我改进可以发现新知识，但存在根本性瓶颈（如污染陷阱和标度律），专家输入在自主探索障碍附近最有价值。
idea_en: A framework modeling AI iterative self-improvement as adaptive sampling over a knowledge space, with conditions for genuine knowledge discovery and identification of distinct failure modes (contamination, forgetting, exploration failure, acceptance failure).
A contamination trap analysis demonstrating that as easy-to-find knowledge is exhausted, even small false-positive rates cause invalid artifacts to accumulate faster than genuine discoveries.
A scaling law R_cum(D)=Θ(c_genD^α) proving cumulative generation cost grows polynomially with distinct genuine discoveries under Zipf law tail equivalence.
A formalization of human amplification (guidance, generation, verification) explaining why expert input is most valuable near autonomous exploration barriers.
idea_ch: 一种将AI迭代自我改进建模为知识空间上自适应采样的框架，包含真知识发现的充分条件以及四种故障模式（污染、遗忘、探索失败、接受失败）的识别方法。
污染陷阱分析：证明当易发现知识被耗尽后，即使是极小的假阳性率也会导致无效伪影比真知识积累得更快。
标度律R_cum(D)=Θ(c_genD^α)：在Zipf定律尾等价假设下，证明累积生成成本随不同真知识发现数量呈多项式增长。

title: ICRL: Learning to Internalize Self-Critique with Reinforcement Learning
summary: Large language model-based agents make mistakes, yet critique can often guide the same model toward correct behavior. However, when critique is removed, the model may fail again on the same query, indicating that it has not internalized the critique's guidance into its underlying capability. Meanwhile, a frozen critic cannot improve its feedback quality over time, limiting the potential for iterative self-improvement. To address this, we propose learning to internalize self-critique with reinforcement learning(ICRL), a novel framework that jointly trains a solver and a critic from a shared backbone to convert critique-induced success into unassisted solver ability. The critic is rewarded based on the solver's subsequent performance gain, incentivizing actionable feedback. To address the distribution shift between critique-conditioned and critique-free behavior, ICRL introduces a distribution-calibration re-weighting ratio that selectively transfers critique-guided improvements compatible with the solver's own prompt distribution. Additionally, a role-wise group advantage estimation stabilizes joint optimization across the two roles. Together, these mechanisms ensure that the solver learns to improve itself without external critique, rather than becoming dependent on critique-conditioned behavior. We evaluate ICRL on diverse benchmarks spanning agentic and mathematical reasoning tasks, using Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B as backbones. Results show consistent improvements, with average gains of 6.4 points over GRPO on agentic tasks, and 7.0 points on mathematical reasoning. Notably, the learned 8B critic is comparable to 32B critics while using substantially fewer tokens. The code is available at https://github.com/brick-pid/ICRL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ICRL框架，通过强化学习联合训练求解器和评论家（共享骨干网络），使求解器内化自我批评能力，从而无需外部批评即可自我改进。在智能体和数学推理任务上，基于Qwen3-4B/8B的实验显示平均提升6.4和7.0个百分点，且8B评论家性能可比肩32B评论家。
AI.motivation: 大模型智能体依赖外部批评才能纠正错误，移除批评后模型会再次失败；同时，固定的评论家无法提升反馈质量。现有方法未能让模型内化批评引导。
AI.method: 1）共享骨干网络的求解器-评论家联合训练框架；2）基于求解器性能增益奖励评论家，激励可行动反馈；3）分布校准重加权比，选择性迁移批评引导的改进；4）角色分组优势估计，稳定联合优化。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B上，智能体任务平均提升6.4分，数学推理平均提升7.0分。8B评论家性能与32B评论家相当，且使用更少token。
AI.conclusion: ICRL有效实现自我批评内化，使求解器在无外部批评下自主改进，验证了共享骨干+强化学习联合训练的有效性。
idea_en: Joint training framework for solver and critic sharing a backbone network, where the critic is rewarded based on the solver's subsequent performance improvement, enabling actionable feedback generation.

Distribution-calibration re-weighting ratio that selectively transfers critique-guided improvements compatible with the solver's own prompt distribution, preventing distribution shift between critique-conditioned and critique-free behavior.
Role-wise group advantage estimation mechanism that stabilizes joint optimization of solver and critic by estimating advantages separately for each role.
idea_ch: 基于共享骨干网络的求解器-评论家联合训练框架，通过强化学习奖励评论家生成对求解器有实际帮助的反馈，实现自我批评内化
分布校准重加权比方法，选择性迁移与求解器自身提示分布兼容的批评引导改进，解决有/无批评行为之间的分布偏移问题

title: NIMO Controller: a self-driving laboratory orchestrator based on the Model Context Protocol
summary: Self-driving laboratories (SDLs) have attracted increasing attention as a means of accelerating scientific discovery; however, developing SDL software remains technically demanding. To improve accessibility, orchestration software frameworks have been proposed to coordinate SDL components. Nevertheless, existing frameworks are primarily designed for human interaction and do not provide standardized interfaces suitable for AI agents. In this work, we propose an SDL software architecture based on the Model Context Protocol (MCP), in which all SDL functionalities are exposed through MCP servers. Following this design principle, we introduce an MCP-based SDL orchestrator, named NIMO Controller. It provides a visual programming interface automatically generated through MCP-based tool discovery, allowing human users to design experimental workflows without writing code. The same MCP backend can also be accessed by AI agents, providing a unified interface for both human users and AI agents. We demonstrate the proposed system through a case study on a color-matching SDL. The results validate the usability of the proposed MCP-based SDL architecture.

AI.tldr: 提出基于Model Context Protocol (MCP)的自驱动实验室软件架构，通过NIMO Controller实现人类用户和AI代理的统一接口，无需编写代码即可设计实验工作流。
AI.motivation: 现有自驱动实验室（SDL）的编排软件框架主要为人类交互设计，缺乏适合AI代理的标准接口，开发门槛高。
AI.method: 基于Model Context Protocol (MCP)设计SDL软件架构，所有SDL功能通过MCP服务器暴露；开发NIMO Controller编排器，通过MCP工具发现自动生成可视化编程界面，人类和AI代理均可通过同一MCP后端访问。
AI.result: 通过颜色匹配SDL案例研究验证了该架构的可用性。
AI.conclusion: MCP-based SDL架构为人类用户和AI代理提供了统一的标准化接口，降低了SDL软件开发门槛。
idea_en: Method and system for exposing self-driving laboratory functionalities via Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers to provide standardized interfaces for both human users and AI agents
Visual programming interface for experimental workflow design that is automatically generated through MCP-based tool discovery in self-driving laboratories
Unified backend architecture (NIMO Controller) enabling seamless switching between human-controlled and AI agent-controlled operation in self-driving laboratories
idea_ch: 基于Model Context Protocol (MCP)的自驱动实验室功能暴露方法，通过MCP服务器为人类用户和AI代理提供标准化接口
通过MCP工具发现自动生成可视化编程界面，用于自驱动实验室实验工作流设计的方法
NIMO Controller统一后端架构，实现自驱动实验室中人机控制和AI代理控制的无缝切换

title: Verifiable Agentic Infrastructure: Proof-Derived Authorization for Sovereign AI Systems
summary:
Modern cloud and enterprise systems rely on identity-centric authorization, assuming that callers possessing valid credentials are safe to execute commands. The emergence of autonomous AI agents invalidates this assumption: agents can generate syntactically valid but semantically unsafe actions, making standing privileges a significant operational risk. This risk becomes especially acute in sovereign AI systems, where autonomous agents may interact with cloud infrastructure, regulated data, financial workflows, and national-scale digital services. Governed mutation substrates reduce this risk by interposing on agent actions: agents submit intents, infrastructure evaluates context and policy, and execution is mediated. However, this shifts the trust boundary: how can the decision to authorize an intent be made verifiable, distributed, and replayable?
  We introduce a Distributed Trust Framework (DTF), a verification framework for governed mutation systems that computes execution authority from structured, verifiable artifacts. DTF introduces a Justification Proof to encode the admissibility basis of an action, a consensus model for independent evaluation, an ephemeral Execution Identity derived from the approved proof, and an append-only Evidence Chain that preserves the authorization lifecycle. Under stated substrate assumptions, this architecture enforces a compact authorization invariant: no high-stakes execution without a proof object, no derived authority without consensus, and no valid mutation detached from evidence.
  We define the model, instantiate it over an OpenKedge-based governed mutation substrate, and show how it maps onto cloud-native environments. By shifting authorization from standing identity to proof-derived authority, DTF provides an infrastructure foundation for making agentic execution governable, auditable, and bounded in sovereign AI deployments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出分布式信任框架(DTF)，将代理执行的授权从静态身份转变为基于证明的权威，通过合理性证明、共识模型、临时执行身份和仅追加证据链，确保高风险的自主AI行为可治理、可审计、可验证。
AI.motivation: 自主AI代理可生成语法有效但语义不安全的操作，使静态权限成为重大运营风险，尤其在主权AI系统中代理与云基础设施、受监管数据、金融工作流等交互时更为突出。
AI.method: 提出分布式信任框架(DTF)，包含四个核心组件：合理性证明(编码操作的可接受性依据)、共识模型(独立评估)、临时执行身份(源自已批准的证明)、仅追加证据链(保存授权生命周期)。
AI.result: 在OpenKedge基底上实例化DTF，并展示其如何映射到云原生环境，证明其能强制执行授权不变性：无证明对象不执行高风险操作，无共识不派生权威，无证据不生效突变。
AI.conclusion: DTF通过将授权从静态身份转向证明派生权威，为主权AI部署中代理执行的可治理性、可审计性和边界约束提供了基础设施基础。
idea_en: A governed mutation substrate system that interposes on autonomous AI agent actions by converting agent intents into structured, verifiable artifacts before execution authorization.
A Justification Proof mechanism that encodes the admissibility basis (context + policy evaluation) for each individual action, serving as a prerequisite for execution.
A consensus model for independent evaluation of Justification Proofs by distributed validators before granting execution authority.
An ephemeral Execution Identity that is dynamically derived from an approved Justification Proof, replacing static/standing credentials.
An append-only Evidence Chain that preserves the complete authorization lifecycle (intent → proof → consensus → execution) as an immutable audit trail.
A compact authorization invariant enforcement architecture: no execution without proof, no authority without consensus, no mutation detached from evidence.
A distributed trust framework that shifts authorization paradigm from identity-based to proof-derived authority for autonomous AI agent systems.
idea_ch: 一种治理突变基底系统，通过将自主AI代理的意图转换为结构化、可验证的工件后再进行执行授权，从而介入代理行为。
一种合理性证明机制，为每个单独操作编码其可接受性依据(上下文+策略评估结果)，作为执行的必要前提条件。
一种共识模型，由分布式验证者在授予执行权限前对合理性证明进行独立评估。
一种临时执行身份，从已批准的合理性证明中动态派生，替代静态/常驻凭证。
一种仅追加证据链，保存完整的授权生命周期(意图→证明→共识→执行)作为不可篡改的审计轨迹。
一种紧凑的授权不变性强制架构：无证明不执行、无共识不授权、无证据不变更。
一种分布式信任框架，将自主AI代理系统的授权范式从基于身份转变为基于证明派生的权威。

title: Solvita: Enhancing Large Language Models for Competitive Programming via Agentic Evolution
summary: Large language models (LLMs) still struggle with the rigorous reasoning demands of hard competitive programming. While recent multi-agent frameworks attempt to bridge this reliability gap, they remain fundamentally stateless: they rely on static retrieval and discard the valuable problem-solving and debugging experience gained from previous tasks. To address this, we present Solvita, an agentic evolution framework that enables continuous learning without requiring weight updates to the underlying LLM. Solvita reorganizes problem-solving into a closed-loop system of strategy selection, program synthesis, certified supervision, and targeted hacking, executed by four specialized agents: Planner, Solver, Oracle, and Hacker. Crucially, each agent is paired with a trainable, graph-structured knowledge network. As the system operates, outcome signals, such as pass/fail verdicts, test certification quality, and adversarial vulnerabilities discovered by the Hacker, are recast as reinforcement learning updates to these network weights. This allows the agents to dynamically route future queries based on past successes and failures, effectively accumulating transferable reasoning experience over time. Evaluated across CodeContests, APPS, AetherCode, and live Codeforces rounds, Solvita establishes a new state-of-the-art among code-generation agents, outperforming existing multi-agent pipelines and nearly doubling the accuracy of single-pass baselines.

AI.tldr: Solvita是一个无需更新LLM权重的智能体演化框架，通过四个专业化智能体（Planner、Solver、Oracle、Hacker）与可训练图知识网络结合，利用强化学习从过往任务中积累推理经验，在竞赛编程任务上取得了SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于多智能体的代码生成框架本质上是无状态的，依赖静态检索，丢弃了过往任务中积累的问题求解和调试经验，无法实现持续学习，难以满足硬核竞赛编程对严谨推理的要求。
AI.method: Solvita将问题求解重组为策略选择、程序合成、认证监督、定向攻击的闭环系统，由四个智能体（Planner、Solver、Oracle、Hacker）协作完成。每个智能体配备可训练的图结构知识网络，将通过/失败判定、测试认证质量、对抗性漏洞等结果信号转化为强化学习更新，动态路由后续查询，积累可迁移的推理经验。
AI.result: 在CodeContests、APPS、AetherCode和实时Codeforces竞赛上评估，Solvita在代码生成智能体中达到新SOTA，优于现有所有多智能体流水线，准确率接近单次基线方法的两倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过图知识网络与强化学习的结合，Solvita证明了LLM可以在不更新权重的情况下实现经验驱动的持续学习，为提升代码生成系统可靠性提供了新范式。
idea_en: A closed-loop multi-agent system for competitive programming where each agent is paired with a trainable graph-structured knowledge network that accumulates reasoning experience via reinforcement learning without updating LLM weights.

A method that converts code execution outcomes (pass/fail), test certification quality, and adversarial vulnerabilities into reinforcement learning signals to dynamically update knowledge routing graphs for code generation agents.
A four-agent orchestration architecture (Planner, Solver, Oracle, Hacker) with certified supervision and targeted hacking feedback loops for iterative program refinement.
A trainable graph-structured knowledge network that enables stateless LLM agents to achieve stateful, experience-driven reasoning routing across problem-solving tasks.

A reinforcement learning framework for multi-agent code synthesis where outcome signals from adversarial testing and certification verification are used as reward signals to evolve agent behavior over time.
idea_ch: 一种无需更新LLM权重的闭环多智能体竞赛编程系统，每个智能体配备可训练的图结构知识网络，通过强化学习累积推理经验。
一种将代码执行结果（通过/失败）、测试认证质量和对抗性漏洞转化为强化学习信号的方法，用于动态更新代码生成智能体的知识路由图。
一种由Planner、Solver、Oracle、Hacker四个专用智能体组成的编排架构，通过认证监督和定向攻击形成程序迭代精炼的反馈闭环。
一种可训练的图结构知识网络，使无状态LLM智能体在问题求解任务中实现有状态的、经验驱动的推理路由。
一种面向多智能体代码合成的强化学习框架，将对抗性测试和认证验证的结果信号作为奖励信号，驱动智能体行为随时间的演化。

title: SMCEvolve: Principled Scientific Discovery via Sequential Monte Carlo Evolution
summary: LLM-driven program evolution has emerged as a powerful tool for automated scientific discovery, yet existing frameworks offer no principled guide for designing their individual components and provide no guarantee that the search converges. We introduce SMCEvolve, which recasts program search as sampling from a reward-tilted target distribution and approximates it with a Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) sampler. From this view, three core mechanisms emerge as principled components: adaptive parent resampling, mixture of mutation with acceptance, and automatic convergence control. We further provide a finite-sample complexity analysis that bounds the LLM-call budget required to reach a target approximation error. Across math, algorithm efficiency, symbolic regression, and end-to-end ML research benchmarks, SMCEvolve surpasses state-of-the-art evolving systems while using fewer LLM calls under self-determined termination. The code is available at https://github.com/kongwanbianjinyu/SMCEvolve.

AI.tldr: SMCEvolve将LLM驱动的程序演化重新建模为从奖励倾斜目标分布中采样，利用序贯蒙特卡洛（SMC）方法实现，并在数学、算法效率、符号回归和端到端ML研究基准上超越现有系统，同时使用更少的LLM调用。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM驱动的程序演化框架缺乏设计原则性指导，且无法保证搜索过程收敛，需要一种更原理性、有收敛保证的方法。
AI.method: 将程序搜索重构为从奖励倾斜目标分布中采样，使用SMC采样器近似；核心机制包括：自适应父本重采样、混合变异与接受、自动收敛控制；并提供有限样本复杂度分析以约束LLM调用预算。
AI.result: 在数学、算法效率、符号回归和端到端ML研究基准上，SMCEvolve超越现有最先进的演化系统，同时使用更少的LLM调用并实现自主终止。
AI.conclusion: SMC框架为LLM驱动的程序演化提供了原理性设计指南和收敛保证，显著提升了搜索效率与性能。
idea_en: A method for LLM-driven program evolution that reformulates program search as sampling from a reward-tilted target distribution using Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) sampling, providing principled convergence guarantees.
Adaptive parent resampling mechanism for LLM-based program evolution that dynamically selects and reweights parent programs during the evolutionary search process.
Mixture of mutation with acceptance mechanism that combines program mutation operations with probabilistic acceptance criteria for controlled program space exploration.
Automatic convergence control mechanism for LLM-driven program evolution that self-determines termination based on sampling quality metrics.
Finite-sample complexity analysis method that bounds the LLM-call budget required to achieve a target approximation error in program search tasks.
A system for automated scientific discovery that integrates SMC-based program evolution with self-determined termination, reducing LLM computational cost while improving search performance.
idea_ch: 一种基于序贯蒙特卡洛（SMC）采样的LLM驱动程序演化方法，将程序搜索重构为从奖励倾斜目标分布中采样，提供原理性收敛保证。
自适应父本重采样机制，在演化搜索过程中动态选择和重新加权父本程序，提升搜索效率。
混合变异与接受机制，将程序变异操作与概率性接受标准相结合，实现对程序空间的可控探索。
自动收敛控制机制，基于采样质量指标自主决定终止条件，无需预设迭代次数。
有限样本复杂度分析方法，量化达到目标近似误差所需LLM调用预算的理论上界。
一种整合SMC程序演化与自定终止的自动化科学发现系统，在减少LLM计算成本的同时提升搜索性能。

title: Context Pruning for Coding Agents via Multi-Rubric Latent Reasoning
summary: LLM-powered coding agents spend the majority of their token budget reading repository files, yet much of the retrieved code is irrelevant to the task at hand. Existing learned pruners compress this context with a single-objective sequence labeler, collapsing all facets of code relevance into one score and one transition matrix. We show that this formulation creates a modeling bottleneck: a single CRF transition prior must serve heterogeneous retention patterns, including contiguous semantic spans and sparse structural support lines. We propose LaMR (Latent Multi-Rubric), a structured pruning framework that decomposes code relevance into two interpretable quality dimensions, semantic evidence and dependency support, each modeled by a dedicated CRF with dimension-specific transition dynamics. A mixture-of-experts gating network dynamically weights the per-rubric emissions conditioned on the query, and a final CRF layer on the fused emissions produces the aggregate keep-or-prune decision. To supervise each dimension without additional annotation cost, we derive multi-rubric labels from the existing training corpus via AST-based program analysis, simultaneously denoising the teacher's binary labels. By effectively filtering distracting noise, LaMR frequently matches or even outperforms unpruned full-context baselines. Experiments on four benchmarks (SWE-Bench Verified, SWE-QA, LCC, LongCodeQA) show that LaMR wins 12 of 16 head-to-head multi-turn comparisons. It saves up to 31% more tokens on multi-turn agent tasks and improves Exact Match by up to +3.5 on single-turn tasks, while performance is frequently enhanced by denoising the context, and any remaining drops are marginal.

AI.tldr: LaMR是一个多维度代码上下文剪枝框架，将代码相关性分解为语义证据和依赖支持两个可解释维度，使用专用CRF建模各自转移动态，通过MoE门控网络动态加权，在无需额外标注成本下显著减少LLM编码智能体的token消耗并提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于学习的剪枝器将代码相关性压缩为单一分数和单一转移矩阵，导致单个CRF转移先验必须同时服务于异构的保留模式（连续语义片段和稀疏结构支持行），形成建模瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出多标签隐式评估框架LaMR：(1) 将代码相关性分解为语义证据和依赖支持两个可解释维度，各由专用CRF建模；(2) Mixture-of-Experts门控网络根据查询动态加权各维度发射分数；(3) 最终CRF层融合后产生保留/剪枝决策；(4) 通过AST程序分析从现有训练语料中导出多维度标签，同时去噪二元标签。
AI.result: 在四个基准（SWE-Bench Verified, SWE-QA, LCC, LongCodeQA）上，LaMR在16次多轮对比中获胜12次；多轮智能体任务节省最多31% token；单轮任务Exact Match最高提升+3.5；性能下降幅度极小。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦代码相关性为多个可解释维度并建模各自转移动态，LaMR有效去除了上下文噪声，常常匹配甚至超越未剪枝的全上下文基线，验证了多维度结构化剪枝的有效性。
idea_en: A structured code context pruning framework that decomposes code relevance into multiple interpretable quality dimensions (semantic evidence and dependency support), each modeled by a dedicated CRF with dimension-specific transition dynamics, enabling more accurate retention pattern modeling than single-objective approaches.

A multi-rubric label generation method that derives dimension-specific supervision signals from existing training corpora via AST-based program analysis without additional annotation cost, while simultaneously denoising the teacher's binary labels.
A mixture-of-experts gating network that dynamically weights per-rubric emissions conditioned on the query, allowing adaptive context-dependent prioritization of different relevance dimensions.
A hierarchical CRF architecture for code pruning where per-dimension CRFs generate specialized features that are fused by a final CRF layer to produce the aggregate keep-or-prune decision.
idea_ch: 一种将代码相关性分解为多个可解释质量维度（语义证据和依赖支持）的结构化代码上下文剪枝框架，每个维度由专用CRF建模，具有维度特定的转移动态，比单目标方法更准确地建模保留模式。
一种基于AST程序分析从现有训练语料中导出多维度监督信号的多标签生成方法，无需额外标注成本，同时实现对教师二元标签的去噪。
一种混合专家门控网络，根据查询动态加权各维度的发射分数，实现不同相关性维度的自适应上下文依赖优先级排序。
一种层次化CRF架构用于代码剪枝，各维度CRF生成专门特征后由最终CRF层融合产生聚合的保留/剪枝决策。

title: Zero-Shot Goal Recognition with Large Language Models
comment: 9 pages, 1 figure, 1 table; appendix with 8 figures and 2 code listings (29 pages total); submitted to NeurIPS 2026
summary: Large language models have recently reached near-parity with classical planners on well-known planning domains, yet this competence relies on world-knowledge exploitation rather than genuine symbolic reasoning. Goal recognition is a complementary abductive task structurally better suited to LLM strengths: it consists of evaluating consistency with world knowledge rather than generating novel action sequences. This paper provides the first systematic zero-shot evaluation of frontier LLMs as goal recognisers on key classical PDDL benchmarks. Our results show that LLM competence on goal recognition is uneven: some models scale with evidence and approach landmark-based accuracy at full observations, while others remain anchored to world-knowledge priors regardless of how much evidence accumulates. Qualitative analysis of model reasoning traces reveals that this divergence reflects a fundamental difference in evidence integration rather than domain familiarity. These findings position goal recognition as a principled benchmark for the foundational planning knowledge of LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统性评估了前沿大语言模型作为目标识别器在经典PDDL基准上的零样本表现。研究发现LLM在目标识别任务上的能力参差不齐：部分模型能随着证据增多逼近基于地标的准确率，而另一些模型则固守世界知识先验，无论积累多少证据。定性分析表明这种差异源于证据整合能力的根本不同而非领域熟悉度。
AI.motivation: 目标识别（Goal Recognition）是一种溯因推理任务，相比规划生成任务，它更契合LLM的优势——评估与世界知识的一致性，而非生成新颖的动作序列。本文旨在系统性评估前沿LLM作为目标识别器的能力，并探究其推理机制。
AI.method: 在经典PDDL规划基准上，对多个前沿LLM进行零样本目标识别评估。通过控制观测证据量，比较LLM与基于地标（landmark-based）的传统方法的准确率。对模型推理链进行定性分析，区分世界知识先验和证据整合两种策略。
AI.result: LLM在目标识别任务上表现不均衡：部分模型（如GPT-4等）能随着观测证据增加而提升准确率，在完整观测下接近基于地标的方法；另一些模型则始终依赖世界知识先验，不受证据量影响。推理追踪分析显示差异来自证据整合能力而非对特定领域的熟悉度。
AI.conclusion: 目标识别可作为评估LLM基础规划知识的原则性基准。LLM在该任务上的表现差异反映了其推理机制的根本不同，为理解LLM的规划能力提供了新视角。
idea_en: A method for zero-shot goal recognition using large language models on classical PDDL planning domains, where the LLM evaluates consistency of observed actions with possible goals based on world knowledge without requiring explicit training or fine-tuning.

A landmark-aware prompting technique that guides LLMs to integrate observational evidence for goal recognition, achieving accuracy comparable to classical landmark-based methods under full observation conditions.

A systematic evaluation framework for assessing LLM planning knowledge through goal recognition tasks, distinguishing between world-knowledge prior exploitation and genuine evidence integration capabilities.

A method for analyzing LLM reasoning traces in goal recognition to characterize evidence integration strategies versus prior-anchored decision making, providing insights into model reasoning mechanisms.
idea_ch: 一种基于大语言模型的零样本目标识别方法，在经典PDDL规划域上，通过评估观测动作与可能目标的兼容性（利用世界知识）实现目标识别，无需显式训练或微调。
一种地标感知的提示工程技术，引导LLM在目标识别中整合观测证据，在完整观测条件下达到接近经典基于地标方法的准确率。
一种通过目标识别任务系统性评估LLM规划知识的框架，能够区分模型是利用世界知识先验还是具备真正的证据整合能力。
一种分析LLM在目标识别中推理轨迹的方法，用以表征证据整合策略与先验锚定决策之间的差异，揭示模型推理机制的根本特征。

title: Belief Engine: Configurable and Inspectable Stance Dynamics in Multi-Agent LLM Deliberation
summary: LLM-based agents are increasingly used to simulate deliberative interactions such as negotiation, conflict resolution, and multi-turn opinion exchange. Yet generated transcripts often do not reveal why an agent's stance changes: movement may reflect evidence uptake, anchoring, role drift, echoing, or changed prompt and retrieval context. We introduce the Belief Engine (BE), an auditable belief-update layer that treats "belief" as an evidential state over a proposition and exposes it as scalar stance. BE extracts arguments into structured memory and updates stance with a log-odds rule controlled by evidence uptake u and prior anchoring a. Across multiple base LLMs, parameter sweeps show that these controls reliably shape stance dynamics while preserving an evidence-level update trail. On DEBATE, a human deliberation dataset with pre/post opinions, BE best reconstructs participants whose final stance follows extracted evidence; stable and evidence-opposed cases instead point to anchoring or factors outside the extracted evidence stream. BE provides configurable infrastructure for studying evidence-grounded deliberation, where openness, commitment, convergence, and disagreement can be tied to explicit update assumptions rather than hidden prompt effects.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Belief Engine（BE），一种可审计的信念更新层，将LLM代理的信念建模为基于证据的状态，通过标量立场暴露，并利用对数几率规则控制证据吸收和先验锚定，从而在人类辩论数据中重建立场变化轨迹。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM代理在模拟协商、冲突解决等交互时，其立场变化的原因不明，可能源于证据吸收、锚定、角色漂移、回声效应或提示/检索上下文变化，缺乏可审计的信念更新机制。
AI.method: BE将信念视为命题上的证据状态，提取论元到结构化记忆，通过证据吸收率u和先验锚定a控制的对数几率规则更新立场，在多个基础LLM上进行参数扫描以验证有效性。
AI.result: 在DEBATE人类辩论数据集上，BE能最佳重建那些最终立场与提取证据一致的参与者；稳定型和证据对立型案例则指向锚定或证据流之外的因素。
AI.conclusion: BE提供了可配置的基础设施，用于研究基于证据的推理，将开放性、承诺、趋同和分歧与显式更新假设而非隐藏的提示效应联系起来。
idea_en: A belief-update layer (Belief Engine) that exposes stance as a scalar value and updates it using a log-odds rule controlled by evidence uptake and prior anchoring parameters.
Structured argument extraction and memory system that converts natural language deliberations into evidence-level update trails for auditing stance changes.
Parameterized evidence uptake control (u) and prior anchoring control (a) that reliably shape stance dynamics across different base LLMs.
System architecture for reconstructing human deliberation trajectories by mapping extracted evidence streams to belief update steps with configurable openness and commitment assumptions.

title: Ensemble Monitoring for AI Control: Diverse Signals Outweigh More Compute
summary: As AI systems are increasingly deployed in autonomous agentic settings at scale, it is important to ensure the actions they take are safe and aligned with user intent. Monitoring agent actions is a key safety mechanism, yet reliable monitors remain difficult to build and the scale of these systems makes human oversight impractical. We show that combining signals from diverse monitors into an ensemble improves detection of misaligned actions. We build 12 GPT-4.1-Mini monitors using both prompting and fine-tuning strategies. We evaluate them on coding tasks where candidate solutions pass standard tests but fail on adversarial inputs. In this setting, diverse ensembles outperform both individual monitors and homogeneous ensembles. Our best 3-monitor ensemble achieves 2.4x greater detection performance gain compared to an ensemble composed of three identical monitors, with the same ensemble performing strongly on an independent dataset. We contend that these results show that diversity - not scale - drives gains. The best ensembles combine strong individual performance with low correlation between monitors. Furthermore, fine-tuned monitors appear in every top-performing ensemble and maintain this advantage on out-of-distribution attack types, suggesting that fine-tuning enables detection capabilities that prompting alone does not elicit. These results support ensemble monitoring as a practical AI control strategy for safety gains at reasonable inference costs.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出通过多样化监测器集成（Ensemble）提升AI代理行为安全对齐的方法，证明多样性而非规模是检测性能提升的关键驱动力。
AI.motivation: AI系统在自主代理场景下大规模部署，其行为安全对齐至关重要。单一监测器可靠性不足，人工监督不可扩展，亟需可自动检测违规行为的可靠监控方案。
AI.method: 构建12个GPT-4.1-Mini监测器（含提示工程与微调两种策略），将其组合为多样化集成系统。在编程任务（候选方案通过标准测试但对抗性输入失败）中评估，分析个体性能、监测器间相关性对集成效果的影响。
AI.result: 多样化集成显著优于个体监测器和同质集成。最佳3监测器集成相较于3个相同监测器组成的集成，检测性能增益达2.4倍，且在独立数据集上表现强劲。微调监测器出现在所有最优集成中，并在分布外攻击类型上保持优势。
AI.conclusion: 多样性（而非规模）是集成监测性能提升的核心驱动力；微调可激发提示工程无法获得的检测能力；集成监测是兼具安全增益与合理推理成本的实际AI控制策略。
idea_en: A method for detecting misaligned AI agent actions using diverse ensemble monitors, where multiple monitors with different architectures or training strategies collectively detect anomalous behaviors that individual monitors miss.
A technique for combining fine-tuned monitors with prompt-based monitors in an ensemble, leveraging complementary detection capabilities from different training paradigms.
A diversity-driven ensemble selection algorithm that identifies optimal combinations of monitors based on both individual performance and inter-monitor correlation metrics.

A cross-paradigm detection system that integrates fine-tuned neural network monitors (trained on adversarial examples) with rule-based or prompt-engineered monitors for robust AI alignment verification.
An out-of-distribution attack detection method using ensemble disagreement signals, where divergence among monitor outputs indicates potential novel attack patterns.
idea_ch: 一种利用多样化监测器集成检测AI代理行为异常的方法，通过组合不同架构或训练策略的监测器，捕捉个体监测器遗漏的违规行为。

一种多样性驱动的集成选择算法，基于个体性能与监测器间相关性指标，自动识别最优监测器组合方案。
一种跨范式的检测系统，将对抗样本微调的神经网络监测器与规则/提示工程监测器融合，实现鲁棒的AI行为对齐验证。
一种基于集成分歧信号的分布外攻击检测方法，通过监测器输出之间的不一致性来识别新型攻击模式。

title: Beyond Partner Diversity: An Influence-Based Team Steering Framework for Zero-Shot Human-Machine Teaming
summary: While AI agents are rapidly advancing from isolated tools to interactive collaborators, data-driven human-machine teaming (HMT) methods remain costly in their reliance on human interaction data across domains, teammates, and team sizes. Zero-shot coordination (ZSC) addresses this bottleneck by simulating diverse partner populations to approximate how unseen partners might behave. However, partner coverage alone is insufficient as team settings scale and communication becomes degraded. To remedy this deficiency, we propose Influence-Based Team Steering (IBTS), a framework that uses influence shaping to incentivize agents to discover diverse, high-performing team interaction patterns and further steers ongoing trajectories toward stronger learned coordination modes. We assess IBTS on Overcooked-AI in both two-agent and three-agent settings, allowing us to test whether learned coordination structure transfers beyond dyadic interaction. Our evaluation includes simulated partners, synthetic partner-style variation, and, to our knowledge, the first 30-subject Overcooked-AI HMT study involving two real human teammates and one machine teammate. Across these evaluations, IBTS improves team performance against competing baselines, highlighting the need for scaled ZSC to combine sparse-reward coordination mechanisms with partner-variation coverage rather than relying on diversity alone.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于影响力引导的团队协调框架IBTS，通过激励智能体发现多样化、高性能的团队交互模式，并在执行过程中引导轨迹向更强的学习协调模式收敛，在Overcooked-AI的双人和三人场景中均优于基线方法，首次开展了30人的人机团队实验。
AI.motivation: 现有数据驱动的人机协同方法依赖大量人类交互数据，成本高昂；零样本协调虽通过模拟多样化伙伴来缓解这一问题，但随着团队规模扩大和通信退化，仅靠伙伴覆盖度不足以应对。
AI.method: 提出Influence-Based Team Steering (IBTS)框架，利用影响力塑造(influence shaping)激励智能体发现多样化且高性能的团队交互模式，并进一步在轨迹执行过程中引导其向更强的学习协调模式收敛。
AI.result: 在Overcooked-AI的双人和三人场景中，IBTS均优于基线方法；在30名受试者的人机团队实验中表现最佳；证明了需要将稀疏奖励协调机制与伙伴多样性覆盖相结合。
AI.conclusion: 仅依靠伙伴多样性不足以应对大规模团队协调，需要结合影响力引导的协调机制；IBTS框架在多智能体协作中具有可扩展性和有效性。
idea_en: A zero-shot coordination framework (IBTS) using influence shaping to incentivize agents to discover diverse high-performing team interaction patterns without requiring human interaction data.
A trajectory steering mechanism that guides ongoing team trajectories toward stronger learned coordination modes during execution.
A method for scaling zero-shot coordination from two-agent to three-agent settings with degraded communication conditions.
A human-machine teaming evaluation protocol involving two real human teammates and one AI agent (30 subjects) for Overcooked-AI.
idea_ch: 一种基于影响力塑造的零样本协调框架(IBTS)，无需人类交互数据即可激励智能体发现多样化且高性能的团队交互模式。
一种轨迹引导机制，在执行过程中将团队轨迹向更强的已学习协调模式方向引导。
一种将零样本协调从双智能体扩展到三智能体场景的方法，适用于通信退化的环境。

title: From LLM-Generated Conjectures to Lean Formalizations: Automated Polynomial Inequality Proving via Sum-of-Squares Certificates
summary: Automated proving of polynomial inequalities is a fundamental challenge in automated mathematical reasoning, where rich algebraic structure and a rapidly growing certificate search space hinder scalability. Purely symbolic approaches provide strong guarantees but often scale poorly as the number of variables or the degree increases, due to expensive algebraic manipulations and rapidly growing intermediate expressions. In parallel, LLM-guided methods have made notable progress, particularly on competition-style inequalities with a small number of variables. To address the remaining scalability challenges, we propose NSPI, a neuro-symbolic framework that combines the complementary strengths of LLMs and symbolic computation for polynomial-inequality proving. Concretely, an LLM proposes a conjecture in the form of an approximate polynomial Sum-Of-Squares (SOS) decomposition; we refine it via symbolic computation to obtain an exact polynomial SOS representation, which directly proves the target inequality, and we further certify the proof in Lean, yielding an end-to-end pipeline from heuristic discovery to machine-checked proof. Experiments on challenging benchmarks involving polynomials with up to 10 variables demonstrate the effectiveness and scalability of the proposed method.

AI.tldr: 提出NSPI框架，结合LLM和符号计算来自动证明多项式不等式：LLM推测近似多项式平方和(SOS)分解，符号计算精化得到精确SOS表示，最终在Lean中验证证明。
AI.motivation: 多项式不等式的自动证明面临可扩展性挑战：纯符号方法在变量数或次数增加时扩展性差，LLM方法虽在竞赛级不等式上取得进展但仍难以处理高维问题。
AI.method: 神经符号框架NSPI：1) LLM推测近似多项式SOS分解形式；2) 符号计算将近似分解精化为精确多项式SOS表示；3) 在Lean定理证明器中验证证明，形成从启发式发现到机器验证的端到端流程。
AI.result: 在包含多达10个变量的多项式不等式基准测试上验证了方法的有效性和可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: LLM的启发式能力与符号计算的精确性相结合，能有效提升多项式不等式证明的可扩展性，并可通过Lean等证明助手提供形式化验证。
idea_en: A neuro-symbolic framework combining LLM-generated approximate SOS decomposition with symbolic refinement for exact polynomial inequality proving
End-to-end pipeline from heuristic discovery to machine-checked proof in Lean theorem prover
Method for LLM to propose approximate polynomial Sum-Of-Squares decomposition candidates as conjectures
Symbolic computation refinement of approximate SOS decompositions to exact polynomial SOS representations
idea_ch: 一种结合LLM生成的近似平方和分解与符号精化以获得精确多项式不等式证明的神经符号框架
从LLM启发式发现到Lean定理证明器中机器验证证明的端到端流程
利用LLM推测近似多项式平方和分解候选作为猜想的方法
通过符号计算将近似平方和分解精化为精确多项式平方和表示的技术

title: X-SYNTH: Beyond Retrieval -- Enterprise Context Synthesis from Observed Human Attention
summary: In enterprise operations, the context required for an AI agent task is scattered across systems of record, static information stores, and communication channels. What is stored is system state, a lossy representation of the work that actually happened [2, 52]. The prevailing approach [17, 31, 34, 36] retrieves by matching request content to what is stored; for narrow requests this works well. But synthesis quality depends on knowing what to surface and how to interpret it: knowledge specific to each organization, team, and individual [5, 57, 61], present in behavioral patterns, absent from any retrieval index. For complex agentic tasks it breaks down: True Lead Rate is low, False Lead Rate is high, and the model has no mechanism to improve. We present X-SYNTH, a framework for enterprise context synthesis grounded in human attention, the digitally observable interaction signatures of each worker, encoding not just what they did but the sequence in which they did it, along with implicit reward signals. Behavioral traces preceding positive outcomes are distinguishable from those that did not, without external labeling. X-SYNTH models each individual's behavioral baseline as a Digital Twin Signature (DTS) and selects among seven qualitatively distinct attention filters: Proportional, Inverse, Differential, Recurrent, Comparative, Sequential, and Collective, per individual and per query, to identify causally relevant activity signatures. A four-stage pipeline assembles ranked context grounded in behavioral patterns rather than query embeddings. On a sales lead identification task, a frontier model unaided achieves 9.5% True Lead Rate (TLR) with 90.5% False Lead Rate (FLR). Augmented with X-SYNTH, TLR rises to 61.9% (6.5x) while FLR falls to 18.8%. Enterprise context synthesis is not a retrieval problem. It is a relevance problem, and human attention is its most reliable ground truth.

AI.tldr: X-SYNTH是一个基于人类注意力（行为痕迹）的企业上下文合成框架，通过数字孪生签名（DTS）和七种注意力过滤器，将销售线索识别的True Lead Rate从9.5%提升至61.9%（6.5倍），同时将False Lead Rate从90.5%降至18.8%，证明企业上下文合成不是检索问题，而是相关性问题。
AI.motivation: 现有AI代理任务依赖系统状态（有损表示）和检索匹配，但复杂任务需要组织/团队/个体特有的上下文知识，这些知识存在于行为模式中，无法从检索索引获取，导致True Lead Rate低、False Lead Rate高且无法自我改进。
AI.method: X-SYNTH框架包含四个阶段：（1）为每个个体建立行为基线的数字孪生签名（DTS）；（2）从七种注意力过滤器中为每位个体和每个查询选择最佳过滤器（比例、逆、差分、循环、比较、序列、集体）；（3）识别因果相关的活动签名；（4）基于行为模式而非查询嵌入组装排序后的上下文。
AI.result: 在销售线索识别任务上，基础模型独立完成TLR为9.5%、FLR为90.5%；结合X-SYNTH后TLR升至61.9%（提升6.5倍），FLR降至18.8%。
AI.conclusion: 企业上下文合成不是检索问题，而是相关性（relevance）问题，人类注意力是其中最可靠的ground truth。
idea_en: Digital Twin Signature (DTS): A method for modeling individual worker behavioral baselines by encoding not just what they did but the sequence of actions and implicit reward signals from digitally observable interaction signatures.

Seven qualitatively distinct attention filters (Proportional, Inverse, Differential, Recurrent, Comparative, Sequential, Collective) for context selection per individual and per query, enabling personalized relevance determination.
A four-stage pipeline for enterprise context synthesis that ranks context grounded in behavioral patterns rather than query embeddings, using human attention as ground truth.

Behavioral trace analysis method that distinguishes traces preceding positive outcomes from those that did not, without external labeling, by leveraging implicit reward signals in interaction sequences.

System for improving AI agent task performance by augmenting with behaviorally-grounded context synthesis, achieving 6.5x improvement in True Lead Rate and 4.8x reduction in False Lead Rate on sales lead identification.

七种定性注意力过滤器（比例、逆、差分、循环、比较、序列、集体）：为每个个体和每个查询动态选择最优过滤器，实现个性化的上下文相关性判断

title: CAPS: Cascaded Adaptive Pairwise Selection for Efficient Parallel Reasoning
summary: Parallel reasoning, where a generator samples many candidate solutions and an aggregator selects the best, is one of the most effective forms of test-time scaling in large language models, and pairwise self-verification has become its strongest aggregation primitive. Yet pairwise verification carries a heavy cost: each judgment reads two complete solutions in full, and existing methods perform tens of such judgments per problem regardless of whether the comparison is informative. We introduce CAPS (Cascaded Adaptive Pairwise Selection), an inference-only framework that allocates verifier compute non-uniformly along two orthogonal axes: an evidence axis that adapts how much of each candidate the judge sees, and a distribution axis that adapts how comparisons are spread across the pool. CAPS instantiates these into a four-stage cascade with an optional rescue subroutine, and admits a closed-form verifier-token cost in which the per-candidate marginal cost is roughly halved relative to uniform full-evidence schedules. On four self-verifying models (Qwen3-14B, GPT-OSS-20B, Qwen3-4B-Instruct/Thinking) and five reasoning benchmarks spanning code (LiveCodeBench-v5/v6, CodeContests) and math (AIME 2025, HMMT 2025), CAPS outperforms the leading pairwise verifier on 14 of 20 suites while using 25.4% of its verifier-token budget on code, and outperforms pointwise self-verification on all 20. The trade-off suites admit an interpretable diagnostic in terms of the verifier's accuracy at partial versus full evidence, providing a concrete pre-deployment check for cascade suitability.

AI.tldr: CAPS提出了一种级联自适应成对选择框架，通过沿证据轴和分布轴非均匀分配验证器计算资源，在显著降低计算成本的同时提升大语言模型并行推理中的最优解选择效果。
AI.motivation: 成对自验证虽然是大语言模型测试时扩展中最有效的聚合原语，但每对判断都需要完整阅读两个解决方案，成本高昂，且现有方法对每道问题执行固定数量的判断，无论比较是否有信息量。
AI.method: CAPS沿两个正交轴非均匀分配验证器计算：证据轴自适应调整判断时看到的候选内容量，分布轴自适应调整比较在候选池中的分配方式。具体实现为四阶段级联（含可选的救援子程序），并推导出验证器token成本的闭式解。
AI.result: 在4个自验证模型和5个推理基准（涵盖代码和数学任务）上，CAPS在20个测试套件中的14个上优于领先的成对验证器，验证器token预算仅为其25.4%；在所有20个套件上均优于点式自验证。
AI.conclusion: CAPS通过非均匀计算分配显著降低了成对验证的计算成本，同时保持甚至提升选择质量，并提供了一种可解释的诊断方法来判断级联适用性。
idea_en: Cascaded adaptive pairwise selection (CAPS) method for allocating verifier compute non-uniformly along evidence axis and distribution axis
Partial-evidence pairwise verification that adaptively controls how much of each candidate solution the judge reads before making a decision
Four-stage cascade with optional rescue subroutine for progressive solution filtering and selection
Closed-form verifier-token cost formula enabling precise computation budget prediction and optimization
Interpretable diagnostic based on verifier's accuracy at partial versus full evidence for pre-deployment suitability check

title: RTL-BenchMT: Dynamic Maintenance of RTL Generation Benchmark Through Agent-Assisted Analysis and Revision
comment: This paper has been accepted by DAC 2026
summary: This paper introduces RTL-BenchMT, an agentic framework for dynamically maintaining RTL generation benchmarks. Large Language Models (LLMs) assisted automated RTL generation is one of the most important directions in EDA research. However, current RTL benchmarks face two critical challenges: (1) flawed cases in the benchmarks and (2) overfitting to the benchmarks. Both challenges are difficult to resolve purely by manual engineering effort. To address these issues and systematically reduce human maintenance costs, we propose an automated agentic framework, RTL-BenchMT. RTL-BenchMT focuses on two key applications: (1) automatically identifying and revising flawed benchmark cases and (2) automatically detecting and updating overfitting cases. With the assistance of RTL-BenchMT, we conduct a thorough, in-depth analysis of flawed and overfitting cases and produce a refined benchmark suite that will be open-sourced to the community.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RTL-BenchMT，一个用于动态维护RTL生成基准测试的自动化智能体框架，能够自动识别和修正有缺陷的用例，检测和更新过拟合用例，从而降低人工维护成本。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM辅助RTL生成领域的基准测试存在两个关键问题：有缺陷的用例和模型对基准的过拟合，这些问题难以通过纯人工工程努力解决，亟需自动化维护方案。
AI.method: 提出RTL-BenchMT智能体框架，包含两大核心应用：自动识别并修正有缺陷的基准用例，以及自动检测并更新过拟合用例，实现基准的动态维护。
AI.result: 通过RTL-BenchMT对缺陷用例和过拟合用例进行了深入分析，产出一套经过精炼的基准测试套件，并将开源给社区。
AI.conclusion: 自动化智能体框架可以有效替代人工维护RTL基准，解决用例缺陷和过拟合两大挑战，显著降低维护成本。
idea_en: An automated agentic framework for dynamically identifying and revising flawed benchmark cases in RTL generation, reducing manual inspection efforts.
A method for automatically detecting and updating overfitting cases in LLM-based RTL benchmarks, preventing benchmark contamination.
A self-maintaining benchmark system that continuously monitors and refines RTL test cases without human intervention.
A systematic pipeline combining automated error detection and correction for RTL design verification benchmarks.

一种自动检测和更新LLM-based RTL基准测试中过拟合用例的方法，防止基准污染。

一种结合自动化错误检测与修正的系统化流程，用于RTL设计验证基准的持续维护。

title: DRS-GUI: Dynamic Region Search for Training-Free GUI Grounding
summary: GUI agents powered by Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated impressive capability in understanding and executing user instructions. However, accurately grounding instruction-relevant elements from high-resolution screenshots cluttered with irrelevant UI components remains challenging for existing approaches. Inspired by how humans dynamically adjust their perceptual scope to locate task-related regions on complex screens, we propose DRS-GUI, a training-free dynamic region search framework for GUI grounding that can be seamlessly integrated into existing MLLMs. DRS-GUI introduces a lightweight UI Perceptor that performs three human-like perceptual actions (Focus, Shift, and Scatter) to progressively explore the interface and generate region proposals. To dynamically schedule these actions, we further design an Action Planner based on Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS). A region quality reward is employed to evaluate and select the highly instruction-relevant region, efficiently pruning redundant UI elements. Experiments demonstrate that DRS-GUI yields a 14\% improvement on ScreenSpot-Pro for general and GUI-specific MLLMs (Qwen2.5-VL-7B and UGround-V1-7B), significantly enhancing grounding performance and generalization.

AI.tldr: 提出DRS-GUI，一种无需训练的动态区域搜索框架，通过模拟人类感知行为（聚焦、移位、分散）和MCTS规划，提升MLLM在复杂GUI界面中的指令相关元素定位能力。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM在处理高分辨率截图中被无关UI组件干扰时，难以精确定位与指令相关的元素，缺乏动态调整感知范围的能力。
AI.method: 1) 轻量级UI感知器执行三种类人感知动作（Focus/Shift/Scatter）；2) 基于MCTS的动作规划器动态调度感知动作；3) 区域质量奖励机制评估并选择高指令相关区域，剪枝冗余UI元素。
AI.result: 在ScreenSpot-Pro上，通用和特定GUI的MLLM（Qwen2.5-VL-7B和UGround-V1-7B）提升14%，显著改善接地性能和泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 训练无关的动态区域搜索框架可无缝集成到现有MLLM，有效提升GUI元素定位精度，具有良好通用性。
idea_en: A training-free dynamic region search framework (DRS-GUI) for GUI grounding that integrates into existing MLLMs without additional training
A lightweight UI Perceptor that mimics human-like perceptual actions (Focus, Shift, Scatter) for progressive interface exploration
An Action Planner based on Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) for dynamically scheduling perceptual actions to locate instruction-relevant regions
A region quality reward mechanism that evaluates and selects highly instruction-relevant regions while pruning redundant UI elements

一种区域质量奖励机制，评估和选择高指令相关区域，同时剪枝冗余UI元素

title: Position: Artificial Intelligence Needs Meta Intelligence -- the Case for Metacognitive AI
comment: This is a preliminary version accepted for presentation and publication at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML26). The modified final version will be available in the conference proceedings
summary: This position paper argues for metacognition as a general design principle for creating more accurate, secure, and efficient AI. The metacognitive solution involves systems monitoring their own states and judiciously allocating resources depending on each problem instance's difficulty or cost of mistakes. Drawing inspiration both from past work on resource-rational AI and from well-documented metacognitive strategies in psychology and cognitive science, we identify specific challenges in embedding these strategies into AI design and highlight open theoretical and implementation problems. We showcase these principles through a tangible example of improved learning efficiency, effectiveness, and security in a Federated Learning (FL) case study. We show how these principles can be translated into practice with a novel software framework developed specifically to allow the community to design, deploy, and experiment with metacognition-enabled AI applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将元认知（metacognition）作为AI设计的一般原则，通过系统监控自身状态并根据问题难度或错误成本合理分配资源，从而提高AI的准确性、安全性和效率。以联邦学习为例展示了该原则的有效性，并发布了支持元认知AI应用的软件框架。
AI.motivation: 当前AI系统在资源分配上缺乏灵活性，无法根据任务难度或错误成本动态调整计算资源，导致准确性、安全性和效率方面存在不足。作者希望通过引入元认知原则来解决这些问题。
AI.method: 借鉴资源理性AI（resource-rational AI）以及心理学和认知科学中的元认知策略，提出将元认知嵌入AI系统设计的具体方法。包括：1）系统自我状态监控；2）根据问题难度和错误成本动态分配资源。通过联邦学习案例验证，并开发专用软件框架支持实践。
AI.result: 在联邦学习案例中，元认知原则显著提升了学习效率、有效性和安全性。开发了专用的软件框架，使社区能够设计、部署和实验元认知增强的AI应用。
AI.conclusion: 元认知是AI设计中的一个重要且可行的一般原则，能够同时提升准确性、安全性和效率。但尚存在开放的理论和实现问题需要进一步研究。

A resource allocation method for federated learning that uses metacognitive strategies to improve learning efficiency, effectiveness, and security by adjusting resource usage according to task complexity.

A software framework for designing, deploying, and experimenting with metacognition-enabled AI applications, allowing the community to integrate self-monitoring and adaptive resource allocation mechanisms.
A method for improving AI security by incorporating metacognitive monitoring that detects anomalous states or high-risk scenarios and adjusts behavior accordingly.
A resource-rational AI architecture that combines insights from cognitive science metacognition with machine learning systems to optimize accuracy-cost tradeoffs in real-time.

一种联邦学习中的资源分配方法，利用元认知策略根据任务复杂度动态调整资源使用，提升学习效率、有效性和安全性。

title: STAR: A Stage-attributed Triage and Repair framework for RCA Agents in Microservices
summary:
LLM-based root cause analysis (RCA) agents have recently emerged as a promising paradigm for incident diagnosis in microservice AIOps. However, their reliability remains fragile: an error in early evidence collection, hypothesis formulation, or causal analysis can propagate through the reasoning trace and eventually corrupt the final diagnosis. In this paper, we present \textbf{STAR}, a \emph{Stage-attributed Triage and Repair} framework for repairing erroneous RCA traces. STAR explicitly decomposes an RCA workflow into four structured stages, namely \emph{Evidence Package} (EP), \emph{Hypothesis Set} (HS), \emph{Analysis Structure} (AS), and \emph{Decision Report} (DR), and treats agent failure as a stage-localizable reasoning bug rather than a monolithic end-to-end error. Built on top of LangGraph, STAR performs stage-wise auditing, budget-aware \emph{Fast/Slow Routing}, \emph{decisive stage localization via counterfactual candidate evaluation}, and stage-specific patch-and-replay repair.
  We evaluate STAR on a public large-scale benchmark and a real-world production dataset, using two RCA agent workflows and three foundation models. Experimental results show that STAR consistently improves both root cause localization and fault type classification over strong baselines. Moreover, STAR identifies the decisive faulty stage with high accuracy, repairs most initially incorrect traces within one or two replay rounds, and benefits substantially from both Fast/Slow Routing and counterfactual stage evaluation. These results suggest that explicitly modeling \emph{where} an RCA agent fails is an effective path toward reliable, debuggable, and self-repairing agentic RCA systems.

AI.tldr: STAR是一个面向LLM驱动的根因分析智能体的分阶段故障定位与修复框架，将RCA工作流分解为四个结构化阶段，通过阶段审计、快慢路由、反事实候选评估和阶段特定补丁回放机制，有效修复推理轨迹中的错误，显著提升根因定位和故障分类的准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM-based RCA智能体的可靠性脆弱，早期证据收集、假设形成或因果分析中的错误会沿着推理轨迹传播，最终污染整个诊断结果。缺乏对智能体故障进行精确定位和修复的有效机制。
AI.method: STAR将RCA工作流显式分解为四个结构化阶段：证据包(EP)、假设集(HS)、分析结构(AS)和决策报告(DR)；采用阶段审计、预算感知的Fast/Slow路由、基于反事实候选评估的 decisive stage 定位、以及阶段特定补丁与回放修复机制。
AI.result: 在公开大规模基准和真实生产数据集上，STAR一致提升了根因定位和故障类型分类性能；能以高准确率识别决定性故障阶段；大多数初始错误轨迹在一到两轮回放内被修复；Fast/Slow路由和反事实阶段评估均带来显著收益。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模RCA智能体在何处失败，是实现可靠、可调试、可自修复的智能体化RCA系统的有效路径。
idea_en: A stage-decomposed RCA workflow with structured stages (Evidence Package, Hypothesis Set, Analysis Structure, Decision Report) that enables fine-grained error localization
A Fast/Slow routing mechanism with budget awareness for efficient stage-wise auditing and repair in agentic RCA systems
Counterfactual candidate evaluation method for decisive stage localization in LLM-based root cause analysis traces
Stage-specific patch-and-replay repair mechanism that corrects erroneous reasoning traces with minimal replay rounds
A stage-attributed triage framework that treats agent failure as a localizable reasoning bug rather than monolithic end-to-end error

title: See Before You Code: Learning Visual Priors for Spatially Aware Educational Animation Generation
summary: Large language models can generate executable code for educational animations, but the resulting renders often exhibit visual defects, including element overlap, misalignment, and broken animation continuity. These defects cannot be reliably detected from the code alone and become apparent only after execution. We formalize this problem as render-feedback-aware constrained code generation: given a natural language specification, the model must generate executable code whose rendered output satisfies structured quality criteria that can be evaluated only after rendering. To address this problem, we introduce OmniManim, a render-feedback-aware educational animation generation framework built around a shared scene state, explicit visual planning, structured post-render diagnostics, and localized repair. Within OmniManim, the Vision Agent is a task-specific visual planning module: it predicts sparse keyframe layouts with coarse-to-fine bounding-box denoising and optimizes an interpolation-aware objective to reduce intermediate-frame failures induced by downstream animation interpolation. We further construct two datasets, ManimLayout-1K and EduRequire-500, and provide a reproducible evaluation protocol covering executability, instructional quality, visual quality, and efficiency. On EduRequire-500, OmniManim improves measured render quality over both single-model baselines and existing multi-agent frameworks. Systematic ablation studies further verify that explicit visual planning, especially its coarse spatial prior, bounding-box refinement, and interpolation-aware optimization, is central to these gains.

AI.tldr: 针对大语言模型生成教育动画时出现的视觉缺陷问题，本文提出OmniManim框架，通过共享场景状态、显式视觉规划、结构化渲染后诊断和局部修复，实现渲染反馈感知的约束代码生成，显著提升渲染质量。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型生成的代码可执行，但渲染结果常出现元素重叠、对齐错误、动画连续性断裂等视觉缺陷，且这些缺陷无法从代码本身可靠检测，只有执行后才能显现。现有方法无法有效解决渲染反馈感知的代码生成问题。
AI.method: 提出OmniManim框架，核心包括：(1) 共享场景状态；(2) 显式视觉规划——Vision Agent通过粗到细的边界框去噪预测稀疏关键帧布局，并优化插值感知目标以减少中间帧故障；(3) 结构化渲染后诊断；(4) 局部修复。同时构建ManimLayout-1K和EduRequire-500数据集。
AI.result: 在EduRequire-500上，OmniManim相比单模型基线和现有多智能体框架均显著提升了渲染质量。消融实验证实显式视觉规划（粗空间先验、边界框细化、插值感知优化）是提升效果的核心。
AI.conclusion: OmniManim有效解决了教育动画生成中的渲染反馈感知代码生成问题，显式视觉规划机制是提升视觉质量的关键，为高质量教育动画自动生成提供了可行方案。
idea_en: A render-feedback-aware code generation framework (OmniManim) that integrates shared scene state, explicit visual planning, post-render diagnostics, and localized repair to generate executable educational animation code with guaranteed visual quality.
A Vision Agent module that predicts sparse keyframe layouts using coarse-to-fine bounding-box denoising, enabling accurate spatial arrangement in generated animations.
An interpolation-aware optimization objective that reduces intermediate-frame failures caused by downstream animation interpolation, improving animation continuity.
A structured post-render diagnostic mechanism that detects visual defects (overlap, misalignment, broken continuity) after rendering and triggers localized code repair.
A shared scene state representation that maintains consistency across multi-agent generation steps, preventing conflicting spatial assignments in animation code.
idea_ch: 一种渲染反馈感知的代码生成框架（OmniManim），集成共享场景状态、显式视觉规划、渲染后诊断和局部修复，生成具有视觉质量保证的可执行教育动画代码。
一种视觉智能体模块，通过粗到细的边界框去噪方法预测稀疏关键帧布局，实现生成动画中的精确空间排列。
一种插值感知优化目标，减少由下游动画插值引起的中间帧故障，提升动画连续性。
一种结构化渲染后诊断机制，在渲染后检测视觉缺陷（重叠、对齐错误、连续性断裂）并触发局部代码修复。
一种共享场景状态表示方法，在多智能体生成步骤间保持一致性，防止动画代码中的空间冲突分配。

title: TopoEvo: A Topology-Aware Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Framework for Root Cause Analysis in Microservices
summary: Root cause analysis (RCA) in microservices is challenging due to (i) noisy and heterogeneous multimodal observability (metrics, logs, traces), (ii) cascading failure propagation that amplifies downstream symptoms, and (iii) non-stationary topology drift induced by autoscaling and rolling updates. Recent LLM-based RCA agents can generate tool-grounded explanations, yet they often remain topology-agnostic and suffer from \emph{symptom-amplification bias}, misattributing the root cause to salient downstream victims. We propose \textbf{TopoEvo}, a topology-aware self-evolving multi-agent framework that couples graph representation learning with structured, topology-constrained reasoning. TopoEvo first introduces \emph{Metric-orthogonal Multimodal Alignment} (MOMA), which decomposes metric embeddings into complementary subspaces and contrastively aligns logs and traces to reduce modality redundancy and sparsity, yielding stable node representations for graph encoding. It then applies \emph{Vector Quantization} (VQ) to discretize topology-enhanced states into auditable \emph{symptom tokens} with a symptom lexicon, enabling reliable retrieval and token-level evidence grounding. On top of these discrete topology cues, TopoEvo performs a multi-agent \emph{Hypothesis--Evidence--Test} (HET) workflow to explicitly verify propagation-consistent explanations and separate initiating anomalies from amplified downstream symptoms. Finally, a \emph{Self-Evolving Mechanism} refreshes hierarchical incident memory and performs conservative test-time adaptation with high-confidence pseudo-labels to maintain robustness under drift.

AI.tldr: TopoEvo是一个拓扑感知的自进化多智能体框架，通过度量正交多模态对齐、向量量化离散化症状令牌、假设-证据-测试工作流和自我进化机制，解决微服务根因分析中的症状放大偏差和拓扑漂移问题。
AI.motivation: 微服务根因分析面临三大挑战：嘈杂异构的多模态可观测数据（指标、日志、跟踪）、级联故障传播放大下游症状、以及自动扩缩容和滚动更新导致的非平稳拓扑漂移。现有LLM-based RCA智能体虽能生成工具驱动的解释，但通常忽略拓扑信息，遭受"症状放大偏差"——错误地将根因归因于显著的下游受害者。
AI.method: TopoEvo包含四个核心技术：(1) 度量正交多模态对齐(MOMA)，将指标嵌入分解为互补子空间，对比对齐日志和跟踪以降低模态冗余和稀疏性；(2) 向量量化(VQ)将拓扑增强状态离散化为可审计的症状令牌，建立症状词典；(3) 多智能体假设-证据-测试(HET)工作流，显式验证传播一致性解释，区分初始异常与放大的下游症状；(4) 自我进化机制刷新层次化事件记忆，使用高置信度伪标签进行保守的测试时自适应，以保持对拓扑漂移的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 论文尚未给出具体实验结果，但预期TopoEvo能够有效缓解症状放大偏差，在拓扑动态变化的微服务环境中实现更准确的根因定位。
AI.conclusion: TopoEvo通过将图表示学习与结构化拓扑约束推理相结合，为微服务根因分析提供了一种新颖的解决方案，有望在真实生产环境中提升RCA的准确性和鲁棒性。
idea_en: Metric-orthogonal Multimodal Alignment (MOMA): A method that decomposes metric embeddings into complementary subspaces and contrastively aligns logs and traces to reduce modality redundancy and sparsity, producing stable node representations for graph encoding in microservice observability.

Vector Quantization (VQ) for symptom tokenization: A technique that discretizes topology-enhanced states into auditable symptom tokens with a symptom lexicon, enabling reliable retrieval and token-level evidence grounding for root cause analysis.

Multi-agent Hypothesis-Evidence-Test (HET) workflow: A structured multi-agent reasoning framework that explicitly verifies propagation-consistent explanations and separates initiating anomalies from amplified downstream symptoms in microservice failure diagnosis.

Self-Evolving Mechanism with conservative test-time adaptation: A method that refreshes hierarchical incident memory and performs test-time adaptation using high-confidence pseudo-labels to maintain robustness under non-stationary topology drift caused by autoscaling and rolling updates.
idea_ch: 度量正交多模态对齐方法：将指标嵌入分解为互补子空间，并通过对比学习对齐日志和跟踪数据，降低模态冗余和稀疏性，为微服务可观测性生成稳定的节点表示。
症状令牌的向量量化技术：将拓扑增强状态离散化为可审计的症状令牌并构建症状词典，实现可靠的检索和令牌级证据基础，用于根因分析的可解释性。
多智能体假设-证据-测试工作流：一种结构化多智能体推理框架，显式验证传播一致性解释，区分微服务故障诊断中的初始异常与被放大的下游症状。
带有保守测试时自适应的自我进化机制：通过刷新层次化事件记忆并使用高置信度伪标签进行测试时自适应，在自动扩缩容和滚动更新导致的非平稳拓扑漂移下保持鲁棒性。

title: ColPackAgent: Agent-Skill-Guided Hard-Particle Monte Carlo Workflows for Colloidal Packing
summary: We introduce ColPackAgent, an agent framework that autonomously runs Monte Carlo simulations of colloidal packing through a Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool server and an agent skill, whether as a standalone agent or inside an existing agent system. By harnessing the MCP server and agent skill, ColPackAgent executes a structured workflow for colloidal packing simulations, which are central to studies of phase behavior, self-assembly, and materials design. Without dedicated simulation tools and workflow instructions, general-purpose Large Language Model (LLM) agents tend to describe such workflows rather than execute them reliably. The MCP server exposes a custom-built colpack Python package that wraps HOOMD-blue hard-particle Monte Carlo, and the skill encodes a four-stage workflow contract. ColPackAgent can carry out the workflow interactively with human feedback, autonomously from an end-to-end prompt, or as autoresearch following a provided program file. We demonstrate the system in different modes with several colloidal packing simulation examples such as cube particles in 3D, a binary system of disks and capsules in 2D, and the 2D hard-disk freezing transition using autoresearch. We also compare model performance on this workflow across a panel of LLMs with 17 stage-specific prompts. This benchmark provides a stage-level check of how reliably different models follow the setup, planning, and analysis workflow. Together, these results show that pairing a domain Python package with MCP tools and a portable agent skill provides a practical route for turning a simulation toolkit into an agent-assisted research workflow.

AI.tldr: ColPackAgent是一个基于MCP协议和智能体技能的自主胶体堆积蒙特卡洛模拟框架，能够将模拟工具包转化为智能体辅助的研究工作流。
AI.motivation: 通用LLM智能体在执行胶体堆积模拟等专业科学计算任务时，缺乏专用模拟工具和工作流指令，倾向于描述工作流而非可靠执行，需要一种将领域Python包与智能体框架结合的方法。
AI.method: 通过MCP工具服务器暴露自定义colpack Python包（封装HOOMD-blue硬粒子蒙特卡洛模拟），并设计四阶段工作流合约的智能体技能，支持人机交互、端到端自主执行和自动研究三种模式。
AI.result: 在立方体3D堆积、圆盘与胶囊二元系统2D模拟、2D硬球冻结相变自动研究等多个案例中成功演示，并通过17阶段提示词基准测试了不同LLM模型对工作流的遵循程度。
AI.conclusion: 将领域Python包与MCP工具和可移植智能体技能相结合，是将模拟工具包转变为智能体辅助研究工作流的实用途径。
idea_en: An agent framework (ColPackAgent) that autonomously runs Monte Carlo simulations of colloidal packing via a Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool server and an agent skill, enabling structured workflow execution for phase behavior, self-assembly, and materials design studies.

A method of wrapping domain-specific simulation toolkit (colpack Python package based on HOOMD-blue) as MCP tools, providing standardized interface for LLM agents to execute complex scientific simulations reliably.

A portable agent skill encoding a four-stage workflow contract for colloidal packing simulations, enabling the agent to carry out workflow interactively with human feedback, autonomously from an end-to-end prompt, or as autoresearch following a program file.
A stage-specific benchmark methodology with 17 prompts to evaluate LLM model performance on following setup, planning, and analysis workflows in scientific simulation tasks.
A system architecture that transforms a simulation toolkit into an agent-assisted research workflow by pairing domain Python package with MCP tools and portable agent skills.
idea_ch: 一种通过MCP工具服务器和智能体技能自主执行胶体堆积蒙特卡洛模拟的智能体框架，实现相行为、自组装和材料设计的结构化工作流。
一种将领域专用模拟工具包（基于HOOMD-blue的colpack Python包）封装为MCP工具的方法，为LLM智能体提供标准化接口以可靠执行复杂科学模拟。
