一种包含17个阶段特定提示词的LLM模型性能基准测试方法，用于评估模型在科学模拟任务中对设置、规划和分析工作流的遵循程度。
一种将模拟工具包转化为智能体辅助研究工作流的系统架构，通过配对领域Python包、MCP工具和可移植智能体技能实现。

title: PRISM: Prompt Reliability via Iterative Simulation and Monitoring for Enterprise Conversational AI
summary: Deploying large language model (LLM)-driven conversational agents in enterprise settings requires prompts that are simultaneously correct at launch and resilient to the non-deterministic behavioral drift that characterizes production LLM deployments. Existing prompt optimization frameworks address prompt quality as a one-time compile-time problem, leaving open the equally critical question of how to detect and repair prompt regressions caused by silent LLM behavior changes over time. We present PRISM (Prompt Reliability via Iterative Simulation and Monitoring), a closed-loop framework that treats prompt engineering as a continuous reliability engineering problem rather than a one-time authorship task. PRISM takes as input plain-language agent requirements, a set of configured tools and memory variables, and an initial draft prompt. It automatically generates test cases from requirements, simulates full multi-turn conversations against a platform-faithful LLM environment, evaluates pass/fail using an LLM-as-judge, diagnoses root causes of failures, and surgically repairs the prompt -- iterating until all tests pass. Critically, PRISM is designed to run on a scheduled basis (daily), treating LLM behavioral drift as a first-class reliability concern. We evaluate PRISM across 35 enterprise conversational agents over a three-week deployment period on the Yellow.ai V3 platform. PRISM reduces median prompt authoring time from 2 days to under 30 minutes, achieves 99% production reliability across all evaluated agents, and successfully identifies and repairs production regressions caused by LLM behavioral drift within a 24-hour detection window. Our results suggest that continuous, simulation-driven prompt optimization is both tractable and necessary for reliable enterprise conversational AI at scale.

AI.tldr: PRISM是一个闭环框架，将提示工程视为持续可靠性工程问题，通过自动生成测试用例、模拟多轮对话、诊断故障根因并修复提示，实现企业级LLM对话代理的持续提示优化，在35个企业代理上验证将编写时间从2天降至30分钟以内，达到99%生产可靠性。
AI.motivation: 企业级LLM驱动的对话代理面临提示在发布时需要正确，且能抵御生产环境中LLM行为非确定性漂移的双重挑战。现有提示优化框架仅将提示质量视为一次性编译时问题，忽略了如何检测和修复由LLM行为静默变化引起的提示退化这一关键问题。
AI.method: PRISM采用闭环框架：输入自然语言代理需求、配置工具和记忆变量以及初始提示草稿；自动从需求生成测试用例；在平台忠实LLM环境中模拟完整多轮对话；使用LLM-as-judge评估通过/失败；诊断失败根因；精准修复提示；迭代直至所有测试通过。框架按日计划运行，将LLM行为漂移视为一等可靠性问题。
AI.result: 在Yellow.ai V3平台上对35个企业对话代理进行三周部署评估，提示编写中位时间从2天降至30分钟以下，所有评估代理达到99%生产可靠性，成功在24小时内检测并修复由LLM行为漂移引起的生产退化。
AI.conclusion: 持续的、模拟驱动的提示优化对于大规模企业对话AI的可靠性既是可行的也是必要的。
idea_en: A closed-loop prompt reliability engineering framework that treats prompt optimization as a continuous reliability problem rather than a one-time authorship task, using iterative simulation and monitoring (PRISM).
An automated test case generation method that derives test scenarios from plain-language agent requirements for multi-turn conversational agent testing.
A platform-faithful LLM simulation environment that emulates production behavior for accurate multi-turn conversation testing before deployment.
An LLM-as-judge evaluation mechanism for automatically assessing pass/fail outcomes of conversational agent responses in enterprise settings.
A root cause diagnosis and surgical prompt repair method that identifies specific failure causes in LLM agent conversations and applies targeted prompt fixes.
A scheduled (daily) behavioral drift detection and repair system that treats LLM non-deterministic behavior changes as a first-class reliability concern.
A method for automatically repairing prompt regressions caused by silent LLM behavior changes within a 24-hour detection window.

一种从自然语言代理需求自动生成多轮对话测试用例的方法。
一种平台忠实的LLM模拟环境，在部署前准确模拟生产行为进行多轮对话测试。
一种LLM作为评委的自动评估机制，用于判断企业场景中对话代理响应的通过/失败结果。
一种根因诊断与精准提示修复方法，识别LLM代理对话中的具体失败原因并进行针对性修复。
一种按日计划运行的行为漂移检测与修复系统，将LLM非确定性行为变化视为一等可靠性问题。
一种在24小时检测窗口内自动修复由LLM静默行为变化引起的提示退化的方法。

title: Nudging Beyond the Comfort Zone: Efficient Strategy-Guided Exploration for RLVR
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has emerged as a scalable paradigm for improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models. However, its effectiveness is fundamentally limited by exploration: the policy can only improve on trajectories it has already sampled. While increasing the number of rollouts alleviates this issue, such brute-force scaling is computationally expensive, and existing approaches that modify the optimization objective provide limited control over what is explored. In this work, we propose NudgeRL, a framework for structured and diversity-driven exploration in RLVR. Our approach introduces Strategy Nudging, which conditions each rollout on lightweight, strategy-level contexts to induce diverse reasoning trajectories without relying on expensive oracle supervision. To effectively learn from such structured exploration, we further propose a unified objective, which decomposes the reward signal into inter- and intra-context components and incorporates a distillation objective to transfer discovered behaviors back to the base policy. Empirically, NudgeRL outperforms standard GRPO with up to 8 times larger rollout budgets, while outperforming oracle-guided RL baseline on average across five challenging math benchmarks. These results demonstrate that structured, context-driven exploration can serve as an efficient and scalable alternative to both brute-force rollout scaling and feasibility-oriented methods based on privileged information. Our code is available at https://github.com/tally0818/NudgeRL.

AI.tldr: NudgeRL提出了一种结构化、多样性驱动的探索框架，通过在RLVR中引入策略提示（Strategy Nudging）来引导模型生成多样化推理轨迹，并设计统一目标函数分解奖励信号，显著提升了推理能力，在数学基准测试中超越GRPO（8倍rollout预算）和Oracle引导的基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有RLVR方法受限于探索效率：策略只能从已采样的轨迹中学习，暴力扩展rollout数量计算成本极高，而修改优化目标的方法对探索的控制有限。需要一种更高效、可扩展的探索机制。
AI.method: 1) Strategy Nudging：在每次rollout中注入轻量级的策略级上下文（strategy-level contexts），诱导模型产生多样化的推理轨迹，无需昂贵的外部监督。2) 统一目标函数：将奖励信号分解为上下文间（inter-context）和上下文内（intra-context）两个分量，并结合蒸馏目标将发现的行为迁移回基础策略。
AI.result: 在五个具有挑战性的数学基准测试上，NudgeRL平均性能超过使用高达8倍rollout预算的标准GRPO，并且优于使用Oracle引导的强化学习基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 结构化、上下文驱动的探索可以作为暴力扩展rollout和基于特权信息的可行性导向方法的有效且可扩展的替代方案。
idea_en: A method for structured exploration in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) by injecting lightweight strategy-level contexts into each rollout to induce diverse reasoning trajectories without oracle supervision.
A unified optimization objective that decomposes the reward signal into inter-context and intra-context components, enabling fine-grained learning from diverse trajectories.
A knowledge distillation mechanism within RLVR that transfers discovered reasoning behaviors from context-conditioned policies back to the base policy.
A context-driven exploration framework that replaces brute-force rollout scaling with structured diversity, achieving superior performance with significantly lower computational cost.
idea_ch: 一种在可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）中通过向每次rollout注入轻量级策略级上下文来诱导多样化推理轨迹的结构化探索方法，无需Oracle监督。
一种统一优化目标，将奖励信号分解为上下文间和上下文内两个分量，实现从多样化轨迹中进行细粒度学习。
一种RLVR中的知识蒸馏机制，将从上下文条件策略中发现的行为迁移回基础策略。
一种上下文驱动的探索框架，用结构化多样性替代暴力扩展rollout，以显著更低的计算成本实现更优性能。

title: Can We Trust AI-Inferred User States. A Psychometric Framework for Validating the Reliability of Users States Classification by LLMs in Operational Environments
comment: Full survey article with data tables for futher possible replicabilty and comparison
summary:
The use of large language models to assess user states in conversational and adaptive systems is based on the assumption that the metrics used for such assessment are stable and interpretable at the level of individual scores. This paper empirically tests this assumption, focusing on the psychometric reliability of artificial intelligence (AI) measures of user states.
  This study employed replication evaluation procedures to assess the repeatability of a broad set of metrics across three different bimodal large language models (GPT-4o audio, Gemini 2.0 Flash, Gemini 2.5 Flash). Analyses include both individual score reliability and aggregated reliability, allowing us to distinguish metrics potentially useful for real-time adaptation from those that retain their value only in aggregated analyses.
  The results demonstrate that metric reliability cannot be considered a default property in interpretive domains. The lack of stability at the level of individual scores precludes the interpretation of such scores as indicators of user state in real-time adaptive systems, even if these metrics demonstrate stability after aggregation. At the same time, the study indicates that individually unstable metrics can retain analytical utility in post-hoc studies, identifying rules governing interactions and their relationships with user experience parameters such as satisfaction, trust, and engagement.
  The main contribution of this work, besides quantifying the severity of the problem (only 31 of 213 metrics met the criteria), is the proposal of a replicable evaluation framework, enabling measurable evaluations of metric applicability. This approach supports more responsible AI design of adaptive systems, in which the interpretation of results requires explicit validation of reliability and monitoring for violations over time.

AI.tldr: 本文实证检验了大语言模型评估用户状态时指标的心理测量可靠性，发现大多数指标在个体评分层面不稳定（213个指标中仅31个达标），并提出了可复现的评估框架。
AI.motivation: 当前对话和自适应系统使用大语言模型评估用户状态，但假设评估指标在个体评分层面是稳定和可解释的，这一假设缺乏实证检验。本研究旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 采用复制评估程序，在三种不同双模态大语言模型（GPT-4o audio、Gemini 2.0 Flash、Gemini 2.5 Flash）上评估一组广泛指标的重复性。分析包括个体评分可靠性和聚合可靠性。
AI.result: 指标可靠性不能被视为默认属性。213个指标中仅有31个满足可靠性标准。个体评分层面的不稳定性排除了这些指标作为实时自适应系统中用户状态指示器的解释可能性，尽管某些指标在聚合后表现出稳定性。聚合后不稳定的指标在事后研究中仍具有分析价值。
AI.conclusion: 提出了可复现的评估框架，支持对指标适用性进行可测量评估。该框架有助于更负责任的自适应系统AI设计，要求对结果解释进行显式可靠性验证并持续监测。
idea_en: A replicable evaluation framework for assessing psychometric reliability of LLM-based user state metrics in conversational systems, enabling systematic validation of individual score stability before deployment in adaptive systems.

A method for distinguishing metrics suitable for real-time adaptation from those useful only for aggregated post-hoc analysis, based on comparative individual-score vs. aggregated reliability testing across multiple LLM models.
A monitoring system for tracking reliability violations of AI-derived user state metrics over time, ensuring continued validity of interpretative claims in adaptive conversational systems.

A cross-model replication evaluation procedure that tests metric repeatability across different bimodal large language models (e.g., GPT-4o audio, Gemini Flash variants) to establish generalizability of user state assessment.
idea_ch: 基于大语言模型的用户状态指标心理测量可靠性评估框架，可在部署到自适应系统前系统验证个体评分稳定性
区分适用于实时自适应的指标与仅适用于聚合事后分析的指标的方法，基于跨多个LLM模型的个体评分与聚合可靠性比较测试
随时间监测AI派生用户状态指标可靠性违规的系统，确保对话自适应系统中解释性声明的持续有效性
跨模型复制评估程序，在不同双模态大语言模型上测试指标重复性，以建立用户状态评估的泛化能力

title: ALSO: Adversarial Online Strategy Optimization for Social Agents
summary: Social simulation provides a compelling testbed for studying social intelligence, where agents interact through multi-turn dialogues under evolving contexts and strategically adapting opponents. Such environments are inherently non-stationary, requiring agents to dynamically adjust their strategies over time. However, most Large Language Model (LLM) based social agents rely on static personas, while existing approaches for enhancing social intelligence, such as offline reinforcement learning or external planners, are ill-suited to these settings, typically assuming stationarity and incurring substantial training overhead. To bridge this gap, we propose \textbf{ALSO} (\textbf{A}dversarial on\textbf{L}ine \textbf{S}trategy \textbf{O}ptimization), the first framework for online strategy optimization in multi-agent social simulation. ALSO advances social adaptation through two key contributions. (1) ALSO formulates multi-turn interaction as an adversarial bandit problem, where combinations of static personas and dynamic strategy instructions are treated as arms, providing a principled solution to non-stationarity without relying on environmental stability assumptions. (2) To predict rewards and generalize sparse feedback in multi-turn dialogues, ALSO introduces a lightweight neural surrogate to predict rewards from interaction histories, enabling sample-efficient exploration and continuous online adaptation. Experiments on the Sotopia benchmark demonstrate that ALSO consistently outperforms static baselines and existing optimization methods in dynamic environments, validating the effectiveness of adversarial online strategy optimization for building robust social agents.

AI.tldr: 提出ALSO框架，将多智能体社交模拟中的多轮交互建模为对抗性赌博机问题，通过轻量级神经代理预测奖励，实现在非平稳环境下的在线策略优化，超越静态基线和现有优化方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的社交智能体依赖静态人格设定，无法适应非平稳的多智能体对话环境；离线强化学习和外部规划器等方法假设环境平稳且训练开销大，不适合动态策略调整场景。
AI.method: (1) 将多轮交互建模为对抗性赌博机问题，将静态人格与动态策略指令的组合视为臂(arms)；(2) 引入轻量级神经代理，从交互历史中预测奖励，以泛化稀疏反馈并实现样本高效的在线自适应探索。
AI.result: 在Sotopia基准上，ALSO在动态环境中持续优于静态基线和现有优化方法，验证了对抗性在线策略优化对构建鲁棒社交智能体的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 对抗性在线策略优化框架ALSO为多智能体社交模拟中的非平稳性问题提供了有效的解决方案，无需环境稳定性假设，且训练开销小。

A lightweight neural surrogate model that predicts rewards from interaction histories to generalize sparse feedback in multi-turn dialogues, enabling sample-efficient exploration and continuous online adaptation.

An adversarial bandit-based framework for non-stationary social environments that eliminates the need for environmental stability assumptions, applicable to dynamic strategy adaptation in multi-agent systems.

A system for continuously adapting agent strategies in multi-turn dialogues by treating persona-strategy combinations as bandit arms and dynamically selecting optimal arms based on online reward feedback.
A method for reward prediction in sparse-feedback multi-turn interactions using a neural surrogate trained on interaction history, enabling efficient exploration without offline training.

一种轻量级神经代理模型，从交互历史中预测奖励，泛化多轮对话中的稀疏反馈信号，实现样本高效的探索与持续在线适应。
一种对抗性赌博机框架，专门针对非平稳社交环境设计，在无环境平稳性假设的条件下实现多智能体系统的动态策略自适应调整。
一种系统，通过将人格-策略组合作为赌博机臂并基于在线奖励反馈动态选择最优臂，实现智能体在多轮对话中的策略持续自适应。
一种面向稀疏反馈多轮交互的奖励预测方法，利用基于交互历史训练的神经代理，实现无需离线训练的在线高效探索与策略优化。

title: SaaS-Bench: Can Computer-Use Agents Leverage Real-World SaaS to Solve Professional Workflows?
summary: Computer-Using Agents (CUAs) are rapidly extending large language models (LLMs) beyond text-based reasoning toward action execution in more complex environments, such as web browsers and graphical user interfaces (GUIs). However, existing web and GUI agent benchmarks often rely on simplified settings, isolated tasks, or short-horizon interactions, making it difficult to assess capabilities of agents in realistic professional workflows. Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) environments are a natural choice for CUA evaluation, as they host a large share of modern digital work and naturally involve dynamic system states, cross-application coordination, domain-specific knowledge, and long-horizon dependencies. To this end, we introduce SaaS-Bench, a benchmark built on 23 deployable SaaS systems across six professional domains, containing 106 tasks grounded in realistic work scenarios. These tasks require long-horizon execution, cover both text-only and multimodal settings, and are evaluated with weighted verification checkpoints that measure strict task completion and partial progress. Experiments show that representative LLM-based agents struggle on SaaS-Bench, with even the strongest model completing fewer than 4% of tasks end-to-end, exposing limitations in planning, state tracking, cross-application context maintenance, and error recovery. Code are available at https://github.com/UniPat-AI/SaaS-Bench for reproduction.

AI.tldr: SaaS-Bench是一个针对SaaS环境的大语言模型智能体基准测试，包含23个可部署SaaS系统、106个长周期真实工作任务。实验表明最强模型端到端任务完成率不足4%，揭示了现有LLM智能体在规划、状态追踪、跨应用上下文维护和错误恢复方面的严重局限。
AI.motivation: 现有Web和GUI智能体评测依赖简化设置、孤立任务或短周期交互，难以评估智能体在真实专业工作流中的能力。SaaS环境天然具备跨应用协调、领域特定知识和长周期依赖特征，适合作为评测基准。
AI.method: 构建了包含23个可部署SaaS系统、6个专业领域、106个任务的基准测试，任务需长周期执行并涵盖纯文本和多模态场景，采用加权验证检查点评估任务完成度和部分进展。
AI.result: 最强模型端到端任务完成率低于4%，暴露了在规划、状态追踪、跨应用上下文维护和错误恢复方面的严重局限性。
AI.conclusion: SaaS-Bench揭示了当前LLM智能体在真实SaaS工作流中的重大不足，为未来研究提供了评测基准。
idea_en: A multi-step weighted verification checkpoint system for evaluating long-horizon task completion in SaaS environments, using partial progress scoring rather than binary success/failure.
A deployable SaaS system testbed architecture that enables realistic cross-application coordination evaluation for LLM-based agents.
A benchmark methodology for assessing LLM agents' error recovery capabilities in dynamic SaaS system states with long-horizon dependencies.
idea_ch: 一种用于SaaS环境中长周期任务完成度评估的多步加权验证检查点系统，采用部分进度评分而非二元成功/失败判定。
一种可部署的SaaS系统测试台架构，能够真实评估LLM智能体的跨应用协调能力。
一种评估LLM智能体在具有长周期依赖关系的动态SaaS系统状态中错误恢复能力的方法论。

title: Agentic Discovery of Neural Architectures: AIRA-Compose and AIRA-Design
summary: Toward recursive self-improvement, we investigate LLM agents autonomously designing foundation models beyond standard Transformers. We introduce a dual-framework approach: AIRA-Compose for high-level architecture search, and AIRA-Design for low-level mechanistic implementation. AIRA-Compose uses 11 agents to explore fundamental computational primitives under a 24-hour budget. Agents evaluate million-parameter candidates, extrapolating top designs to 350M, 1B, and 3B scales. This yields 14 architectures across two families: AIRAformers (Transformer-based) and AIRAhybrids (Transformer-Mamba). Pre-trained at 1B scale, these consistently outperform Llama 3.2 and Composer-found baselines. On downstream tasks, AIRAformer-D and AIRAhybrid-D improve accuracy by 2.4% and 3.8% over Llama 3.2. Furthermore, AIRA-Compose finds models with highly efficient scaling frontiers: AIRAformer-C scales 54% and 71% faster than Llama 3.2 and Composer's best Transformer, while AIRAhybrid-C outscales Nemotron-2 by 23% and Composer's best hybrid by 37%. AIRA-Design tasks 20 agents with writing novel attention mechanisms for long-range dependencies and high-performing training scripts. On the Long Range Arena benchmark, agent-designed architectures reach within 2.3% and 2.6% of human state-of-the-art on document matching and text classification. On the Autoresearch benchmark, Greedy Opus 4.5 achieves 0.968 validation bits-per-byte under a fixed time budget, surpassing the published minimum. Together, these frameworks show AI agents can autonomously discover architectures and algorithmic optimizations matching or surpassing hand-designed baselines. This establishes a powerful paradigm for discovering next-generation foundation models, marking a clear step toward recursive self-improvement.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AIRA-Compose和AIRA-Design双框架，让LLM智能体自主设计基础模型架构与注意力机制。实验表明，AI设计的架构在多个规模上超越人类设计的基线模型（如Llama 3.2），并在Long Range Arena和Autoresearch基准上接近或超越人类最优水平，展示了AI实现递归自我改进的潜力。
AI.motivation: 当前基础模型架构（如Transformer）主要由人类专家手工设计，探索空间有限。本文旨在探索LLM智能体能否自主发现和设计超越现有范式的新型架构与算法优化，实现递归自我改进。
AI.method: 提出双框架方法：1) AIRA-Compose：使用11个智能体在24小时预算内探索高层架构，筛选百万参数候选，并将最优设计扩展到350M、1B和3B规模，生成AIRAformer（基于Transformer）和AIRAhybrid（Transformer-Mamba混合）两类架构；2) AIRA-Design：使用20个智能体编写新的注意力机制和训练脚本，在Long Range Arena和Autoresearch基准上评估。
AI.result: 在1B规模预训练下，AIRAformer-D和AIRAhybrid-D在下游任务上比Llama 3.2准确率分别提升2.4%和3.8%。AIRAformer-C扩展速度比Llama 3.2快54%、比Composer最佳Transformer快71%；AIRAhybrid-C比Nemotron-2快23%、比Composer最佳混合模型快37%。在Long Range Arena上，智能体设计的架构在文档匹配和文本分类任务上分别达到人类最优水平的2.3%和2.6%以内。Greedy Opus 4.5在Autoresearch上达到0.968验证bits-per-byte，超越已发布的最优值。
AI.conclusion: AI智能体能够自主发现与人类手工设计相匹敌甚至更优的架构和算法优化，这为下一代基础模型的发现建立了强大的范式，标志着向递归自我改进迈出了重要一步。
idea_en: A multi-agent framework (AIRA-Compose) for autonomous high-level neural architecture search, where multiple LLM agents collaboratively explore and evaluate fundamental computational primitives under a fixed time budget, enabling discovery of novel foundation model architectures beyond standard Transformers.

A dual-scale architecture generation method that first evaluates million-parameter candidates, then extrapolates top-performing designs to larger scales (350M, 1B, 3B parameters), bridging the gap between small-scale prototyping and large-scale deployment.

AIRA-Design: a multi-agent system comprising 20 LLM agents that autonomously write novel attention mechanisms optimized for long-range dependencies, generating both the architectural design and high-performing training scripts from scratch.

A Transformer-Mamba hybrid architecture family (AIRAhybrid) discovered by AI agents, combining the strengths of Transformer and state-space model (Mamba) paradigms for improved efficiency and performance.

An agent-discovered attention mechanism that achieves competitive performance on the Long Range Arena benchmark, reaching within 2.3% of human state-of-the-art on document matching tasks without human intervention.

A recursive self-improvement framework for foundation models where AI agents iteratively design improved architectures, enabling autonomous acceleration of AI research beyond human-designed baselines.

20个LLM智能体组成的多智能体系统（AIRA-Design），能够自主编写针对长程依赖优化的新型注意力机制，同时生成架构设计和配套的高性能训练脚本
由AI智能体发现的Transformer-Mamba混合架构族（AIRAhybrid），融合Transformer和状态空间模型（Mamba）的优势，实现更高的效率与性能

title: Imperfect World Models are Exploitable
summary: We propose a novel definition of model exploitation in reinforcement learning. Informally, a world model is exploitable if it implies that one policy should be strictly preferred over another while the environment's true transition model implies the reverse. We analogize our definition with a prior characterization of reward hacking but show that the associated proof of inevitability does not transfer to exploitation. To overcome this obstruction, we develop a general theory of reward hacking and model exploitation that proves that exploitation is essentially unavoidable on large policy sets and yields the corresponding claim for hacking as a special case. Unfortunately, we also find that the conditions that guarantee unhackability in finite policy sets have no counterpart that precludes exploitation. Consequently, we introduce a relaxed notion of exploitation and derive a safe horizon within which it can be avoided. Taken together, our results establish a formal bridge between reward hacking and model exploitation and elucidate the limits of safe planning in world models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出强化学习中世界模型利用（model exploitation）的新定义，证明其在大型策略集上不可避免，并建立了与奖励黑客（reward hacking）的形式化桥梁，同时探讨了安全规划的理论边界。
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏对模型利用（model exploitation）的严格形式化定义，且不清楚其与奖励黑客（reward hacking）之间的关系。本文旨在填补这一理论空白。
AI.method: 提出模型利用的形式化定义，类比奖励黑客但证明其必然性结论不直接迁移；发展统一的奖励黑客与模型利用理论；证明大型策略集上模型利用不可避免；引入松弛的利用概念并推导可避免的安全视界（safe horizon）。
AI.result: 证明了模型利用在大型策略集上本质上是不可避免的；有限策略集中保证无奖励黑客的条件无法推广到模型利用；引入了松弛的模型利用概念并推导了安全视界。
AI.conclusion: 建立了奖励黑客与模型利用之间的形式化桥梁，阐明了世界模型中安全规划的极限。
idea_en: A formal definition of model exploitation in reinforcement learning that identifies when a world model falsely reverses policy preference relative to the true environment.
A unified theoretical framework connecting reward hacking and model exploitation, proving that exploitation is unavoidable on large policy sets.
A relaxed concept of exploitation with a derived safe horizon within which exploitation can be avoided during planning in world models.
A proof that conditions guaranteeing unhackability in finite policy sets do not extend to preclude model exploitation.
idea_ch: 一种强化学习中模型利用的形式化定义，用于识别世界模型相对于真实环境错误反转策略偏好的情况。
一种统一的奖励黑客与模型利用理论框架，证明在大型策略集上模型利用不可避免。
一种松弛的模型利用概念及可避免该利用的安全视界（safe horizon）推导方法。
一种证明有限策略集中保证无奖励黑客的条件无法推广到排除模型利用的方法。

title: PAGER: Bridging the Semantic-Execution Gap in Point-Precise Geometric GUI Control
summary: Large vision-language models have significantly advanced GUI agents, enabling executable interaction across web, mobile, and desktop interfaces. Yet these gains largely rely on a forgiving region-tolerant paradigm, where many nearby pixels inside the same component remain valid. Precise geometric construction breaks this assumption: actions must land on points in continuous canvas space rather than tolerant regions. Because geometric primitives carry ontological dependencies, a local coordinate error can induce cascading topological failures that distort downstream objects and invalidate the final construction. We identify this regime as precision-sensitive GUI tasks, requiring point-level accuracy, geometry-aware verification, and robustness to dependency-driven error propagation. To benchmark it, we introduce PAGE Bench, with 4,906 problems and over 224K process-supervised, pixel-level GUI actions. We further propose PAGER, a topology-aware agent that decomposes construction into dependency-structured planning and pixel-level execution. Pixel-grounded supervised tuning establishes executable action grammar, while precision-aligned reinforcement learning mitigates rollout-induced exposure bias through state-conditioned geometric feedback. Experiments reveal a pronounced Semantic-Execution Gap: general multimodal models can exceed 88% action type accuracy yet remain below 6% task success. PAGER closes this gap, delivering 4.1x higher task success than the strongest evaluated general baseline and raising step success rate from below 9% for GUI-specialized agents to over 62%, establishing a new state of the art for point-precise GUI control.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PAGE Bench基准（4,906个问题，22.4万+精确像素级GUI操作）和PAGER拓扑感知智能体，解决精密几何构建任务中像素级精度的GUI控制问题。PAGER通过依赖结构规划、像素级监督微调和精准对齐强化学习，将任务成功率从6%以下提升至4.1倍于最强通用基线，步骤成功率从9%以下提升至62%以上。
AI.motivation: 现有大视觉语言模型驱动的GUI智能体基于"区域容忍"范式（同一组件内邻近像素均可接受），但在精密几何构建任务中，操作必须精确落在连续画布空间的点上，且几何基元存在本体依赖关系，局部坐标误差会导致级联拓扑故障，使下游对象扭曲并导致最终构建无效。现有模型无法满足这种像素级精度、几何感知验证和依赖驱动误差传播鲁棒性的需求。
AI.method: 1) PAGE Bench：包含4,906个问题和224K+过程监督的像素级GUI操作的基准测试集；2) PAGER智能体：拓扑感知智能体，将构建任务分解为依赖结构规划（dependency-structured planning）和像素级执行（pixel-level execution）；3) 像素级监督微调（Pixel-grounded supervised tuning）建立可执行操作语法；4) 精准对齐强化学习（Precision-aligned reinforcement learning），通过状态条件几何反馈缓解 rollout 引发的暴露偏差。
AI.result: 通用多模态模型动作类型准确率超88%，但任务成功率低于6%。PAGER将任务成功率提升至最强通用基线的4.1倍，步骤成功率从GUI专用智能体的9%以下提升至62%以上，在像素级精确GUI控制任务上达到新SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 发现了通用多模态模型在GUI任务上的"语义-执行鸿沟"（动作类型理解准确但任务完成失败），证明精密几何构建任务需要全新的拓扑感知架构，PAGER通过依赖结构规划和像素级精度执行有效弥合了这一鸿沟。
idea_en: A topology-aware GUI agent architecture that decomposes precision-sensitive construction tasks into dependency-structured planning and pixel-level execution phases, enabling point-level accuracy in geometric construction.
A pixel-grounded supervised tuning method that establishes executable action grammar for vision-language models by training on process-supervised, pixel-level GUI action sequences.
A precision-aligned reinforcement learning approach that mitigates rollout-induced exposure bias through state-conditioned geometric feedback for point-precise GUI control.
A benchmark system (PAGE Bench) containing 4,906 problems and over 224K process-supervised pixel-level GUI actions for evaluating precision-sensitive GUI tasks.
A method for preventing cascading topological failures in geometric GUI construction by modeling ontological dependencies between geometric primitives during action planning.
A semantic-execution gap detection mechanism that independently evaluates action type understanding versus precise geometric execution performance in multimodal GUI agents.

title: Deterministic Event-Graph Substrates as World Models for Counterfactual Reasoning
summary: We study event-graph substrates: a class of world models that represent agent state as an append-only log of typed RDF triples and answer counterfactual queries by forking the log under a structured intervention vocabulary. Substrates are inspectable at the triple level, support exact counterfactuals, and transfer across domains without learned components. We formalize the class, prove a duality between explanatory and counterfactual queries that reduces both to the same causal-ancestor traversal, and evaluate a 1,400-line CLEVRER-DSL interpreter atop a domain-agnostic substrate runtime at full CLEVRER validation scale (n=75,618). The substrate exceeds the NS-DR symbolic oracle on all four per-question categories (by 9.89, 20.26, 17.65, and 0.80 percentage points), and exceeds the parametric ALOE baseline on descriptive and explanatory while lagging on predictive and counterfactual. We also introduce twin-EventLog, a 500-specification Park-canonical Smallville counterfactual benchmark on which the substrate exceeds Llama-3.1-8B with full context by 18.80 points joint accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出事件图基板（event-graph substrates），一种基于可追加RDF三元组日志的世界模型，支持结构化干预下的反事实查询，在CLEVRER和Smallville基准上超越符号和参数化基线。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型要么不可细粒度检查（如神经网络），要么需领域特定工程，缺乏既可审计又跨领域通用的反事实推理框架。

title: Learning Bilevel Policies over Symbolic World Models for Long-Horizon Planning
summary: We tackle the challenge of building embodied AI agents that can reliably solve long-horizon planning problems. Imitation learning from demonstrations has shown itself to be effective in training robots to solve a diversity of complex tasks requiring fine motor control and manipulation over low-level (LL), continuous environments. Yet, it remains a difficult endeavour to generate long-horizon plans from imitation learning alone. In contrast, high-level (HL), symbolic abstractions facilitate efficient and interpretable long-horizon planning. We propose to combine the strengths of LL imitation learning for manipulation and control, and HL symbolic abstractions for long-horizon planning. We realise this idea via \emph{bilevel policies} of the form $(π^{\mathrm{hl}}, π^{\mathrm{ll}})$, consisting of a neural policy $π^{\mathrm{ll}}$ learned from LL demonstrations, and an HL symbolic policy $π^{\mathrm{hl}}$ that is constructed from symbolic abstractions of the LL demonstrations combined with inductive generalisation. We implement these ideas in the BISON system. Experiments on extended MetaWorld benchmarks demonstrate that BISON generalises to long horizons and problems with greater numbers of objects than those solved by VLA and end-to-end methods, and is more time and memory efficient in training and inference. Notably, when ignoring LL execution, BISON's HL policies can solve HL problems with 10,000 relevant objects in under a minute. Project page: https://dillonzchen.github.io/bison

AI.tldr: 本文提出BISON系统，通过双层策略架构结合底层模仿学习（操控精细动作）和高层符号抽象（长时序规划），实现了在长时间跨度任务上的高效泛化与推理。
AI.motivation: 现有方法中，模仿学习擅长底层连续控制但难以生成长时序规划，而高层符号抽象擅长长时序规划但缺乏底层操控能力，如何将两者优势结合是核心挑战。
AI.method: 提出双层策略(π^hl, π^ll)：π^ll从底层演示中学习神经网络策略负责操控；π^hl从底层演示的符号抽象结合归纳泛化构建高层符号策略，两者协同实现长时序规划与精细控制。
AI.result: 在扩展的MetaWorld基准上，BISON在长时序和更多物体的问题上优于VLA及端到端方法，训练和推理的时间与内存效率更高；高层策略可在1分钟内解决含10,000个相关物体的高层问题。
AI.conclusion: BISON证明了底层模仿学习与高层符号抽象的双层结合是一种高效、可泛化且可解释的长时序具身智能规划方案。
idea_en: Bilevel policy architecture (π^hl, π^ll) combining neural imitation learning for low-level control with symbolic abstraction for high-level long-horizon planning
Method for constructing high-level symbolic policies from symbolic abstractions of low-level demonstrations combined with inductive generalization
BISON system enabling efficient and interpretable long-horizon planning that generalizes to problems with up to 10,000 relevant objects

title: Petri Net Induced Heuristic Search for Resource Constrained Scheduling
comment: Accepted at the International Symposium on Combinatorial Search (SoCS 2026)
summary: We formulate the Resource-Constrained Project Scheduling Problem (RCPSP) as optimal search over the reachability graph of a Timed Transition Petri Net with Resources, using relative-delay tokens so that scheduling decisions correspond to transition firings in the induced state space. We solve the resulting problem with $A^*$ guided by a heuristic that combines Critical Path and resource-based lower bounds, and prove that it is consistent under our token-based time semantics. Experiments on the PSPLIB benchmarks show that the approach outperforms strong exact Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MIP) baselines (SCIP, CBC) in both success rate and solve time. Per-instance analysis shows that heuristic search and MIP degrade along independent axes, resource tightness for $A^*$ and formulation size for MIP, with resource strength mediating which solver benefits from scale.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将资源约束项目调度问题（RCPSP）形式化为带资源的定时变迁Petri网的可达图上的最优搜索，使用相对延迟令牌使调度决策对应状态空间中的变迁触发。采用结合关键路径和资源下界的A*启发式搜索求解，并证明该启发式在令牌时间语义下是一致的。PSPLIB基准实验表明，该方法在成功率和求解时间上均优于强大的精确混合整数线性规划基线（SCIP、CBC）。逐实例分析显示，启发式搜索和MIP沿独立轴退化——A*受资源紧度影响，MIP受问题规模影响，资源强度调解了哪种求解器能受益于规模扩展。
AI.motivation: RCPSP是经典的NP难组合优化问题，现有精确方法（如MIP）在问题规模增大时求解效率显著下降，需要更高效的精确求解方法。
AI.method: 将RCPSP建模为带资源的定时变迁Petri网（TTPN），利用相对延迟令牌表示调度时间，将调度问题转化为可达图上的最优路径搜索。使用结合关键路径法下界和资源下界的A*算法引导搜索，并证明该启发式函数满足一致性条件。
AI.result: 在PSPLIB标准基准测试上，该方法在成功求解率和求解时间两方面均显著优于SCIP和CBC等MIP求解器。A*在资源紧度高时性能下降，而MIP在问题规模大时性能下降，资源强度参数决定了哪种方法在大规模问题上更具优势。
AI.conclusion: 基于Petri网可达图搜索的A*方法是求解RCPSP的一种有竞争力的精确方法，与MIP形成互补优势，在某些问题特征下表现更优。
idea_en: Method of formulating RCPSP as optimal search over reachability graph of a Timed Transition Petri Net with Resources using relative-delay tokens, where scheduling decisions correspond to transition firings in the induced state space.
A* search algorithm for solving RCPSP guided by a heuristic combining Critical Path Method (CPM) lower bound and resource-based lower bounds, with consistency proof under token-based time semantics.
Token-based time representation mechanism using relative-delay tokens in Timed Transition Petri Nets for encoding project scheduling states and decisions.

Per-instance analysis framework for comparing heuristic search and MIP solvers on RCPSP based on resource tightness (affecting A*) and formulation size (affecting MIP), with resource strength as mediating factor.

title: ScreenSearch: Uncertainty-Aware OS Exploration
summary: Desktop GUI agents operate under partial observability: visually similar screens can correspond to different underlying workflow states, so locally plausible actions can lead to sharply different outcomes. We frame this as a problem of computer/OS state exploration, where effective behavior requires both expanding the reachable frontier and reducing ambiguity before committing. We present ScreenSearch, a system that combines structural screen retrieval and deduplication with an ambiguity-aware PUCT graph-bandit for large-scale desktop exploration. The retrieval layer converts UIA trees into location-aware structural features, indexes related screens through sparse token search and metadata filters, and maintains a shared deduplicated state graph across VM workers. On top of this graph, we define a scalable ambiguity signal based on matched-action outcome dispersion. If similar screens produce different next states under the same action signature, the state should be probed further rather than treated as resolved. We use this signal together with frontier rewards to drive large-scale exploration and replay-start policy evaluation over the shared graph. Across 11 desktop applications, ScreenSearch collects over 1M screenshots and over 30K deduplicated states, yielding large exploration corpora with substantial cross-application and within-application diversity. On a fixed replay-start slice, we observe a clear novelty--ambiguity trade-off: some policies reduce ambiguity quickly while discovering little frontier. Ambiguity reduction alone is therefore not a sufficient exploration objective. Appendix ablations show that stronger proposal priors can materially improve unique-state discovery during corpus building. These results suggest that state identity, proposal quality, and ambiguity-aware search all matter when deciding when to probe and when to commit.

AI.tldr: ScreenSearch是一个桌面GUI代理系统，通过结构化的屏幕检索与去重，结合基于PUCT的歧义感知图强盗算法，在大规模桌面环境中进行状态探索，收集超过100万张截图和3万多个去重状态。
AI.motivation: 桌面GUI代理面临部分可观测性问题：视觉相似的屏幕可能对应不同的底层工作流状态，局部合理的动作可能导致截然不同的结果。现有方法难以有效区分歧义状态和探索新状态。
AI.method: 1) 结构屏幕检索与去重层：将UIA树转换为位置感知的结构特征，通过稀疏标记搜索和元数据过滤索引相关屏幕，维护跨VM工作者的共享去重状态图；2) 基于PUCT的歧义感知图强盗算法：利用匹配动作结果离散度定义可扩展的歧义信号，结合前沿奖励驱动大规模探索和重放策略评估。
AI.result: 在11个桌面应用中收集了超过100万张截图和3万多个去重状态，生成了具有跨应用和内部多样性的探索语料库。发现新颖性-歧义性权衡：某些策略快速降低歧义但发现较少前沿。
AI.conclusion: 状态身份识别、提议质量和歧义感知搜索在决定何时探测和何时提交时都很重要。歧义减少本身不足以作为探索目标，更强的提议先验可以显著改善语料库构建中的唯一状态发现。
idea_en: A system and method for structural screen retrieval and deduplication that converts UIA trees into location-aware structural features and indexes related screens through sparse token search and metadata filters.
A graph-bandit exploration algorithm (ScreenSearch) that uses ambiguity-aware PUCT to balance frontier expansion and ambiguity reduction in partially observable desktop environments.

A method for defining scalable ambiguity signals based on matched-action outcome dispersion, where similar screens producing different next states under the same action signature trigger further probing.
A shared deduplicated state graph maintained across multiple VM workers for large-scale desktop exploration with replay-start policy evaluation.
A technique for detecting novelty-ambiguity trade-off in GUI agent exploration, enabling adaptive probing vs. commitment decisions based on state identity and proposal quality.
idea_ch: 一种结构屏幕检索与去重系统及方法，将UIA树转换为位置感知的结构特征，通过稀疏标记搜索和元数据过滤索引相关屏幕。
基于歧义感知PUCT的图强盗探索算法（ScreenSearch），在部分可观测的桌面环境中平衡前沿扩展与歧义减少。

title: Reasoners or Translators? Contamination-aware Evaluation and Neuro-Symbolic Robustness in Tax Law
summary: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have significantly enhanced automated legal reasoning. Yet, it remains unclear whether their performance reflects genuine legal reasoning ability or artifacts of data contamination. We present a comprehensive empirical study of tax law reasoning approaches and implement a contamination detection protocol to rigorously assess LLM reliability. We show that performance can be inflated by contamination. Building on this analysis, we conduct a systematic evaluation, comparing monolithic LLMs with hybrid systems that translate statutory text into formal representations and delegate inference to symbolic solvers. We build a novel test suite designed to probe generalization to unseen documents via case and rule variations. Our findings indicate that legal reasoning is inherently compositional and that neuro-symbolic frameworks offer a more reliable and robust foundation for legal AI, as well as improved generalization to unobserved situations.

AI.tldr: 本文通过污染检测协议研究LLM在税法推理中的可靠性，发现数据污染会虚增性能，并证明神经符号框架比纯LLM更稳健、泛化能力更强。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM在法律推理任务中表现优异，但尚不清楚其性能是真实的推理能力还是数据污染导致的假象。需要系统评估LLM在税法推理中的可靠性，并探索更可靠的替代方案。
AI.method: 1. 提出污染检测协议用于评估LLM可靠性；2. 构建新的测试套件，通过案情和规则变体测试模型对未见过文档的泛化能力；3. 比较纯LLM与神经符号混合系统（将法条转为形式化表示，委托符号求解器推理）。
AI.result: 数据污染会显著虚增LLM在税法推理任务上的性能；法律推理具有内在的组合性；神经符号框架比纯LLM更可靠、更稳健，且对未见情况的泛化能力更好。
AI.conclusion: 神经符号框架是更可靠的AI法律推理基础，而纯LLM受数据污染影响严重。
idea_en: A contamination detection protocol for assessing data contamination in legal reasoning tasks with LLMs, enabling rigorous evaluation of whether performance reflects genuine reasoning or memorization.
A hybrid neuro-symbolic legal reasoning system that translates statutory text into formal representations and delegates inference to symbolic solvers, improving reliability and generalization.
A novel test suite for legal AI evaluation that probes generalization to unseen documents via systematic case and rule variations, testing compositional legal reasoning ability.

title: Sign-Separated Finite-Time Error Analysis of Q-Learning
summary: This paper develops a sign-separated finite-time error analysis for constant step-size Q-learning. Starting from the switching-system representation, the error is decomposed into its componentwise negative and positive parts. The negative part is dominated by a lower comparison linear time-invariant (LTI) system associated with a fixed optimal policy, whereas the positive part is controlled by a linear switching system. The resulting bounds show that the negative-side LTI certificate is no slower than the positive-side switching certificate and may produce a faster exponential envelope. The analysis identifies a max-induced asymmetry in Q-learning error dynamics. This asymmetry is connected to overestimation: positive action-wise errors can be selected and propagated by the Bellman maximum, whereas negative errors admit an optimal-policy lower comparison. Finite-time bounds are provided for both deterministic and stochastic constant-step-size recursions.

AI.tldr: 本文对常数步长Q-learning进行了符号分离的有限时间误差分析，通过切换系统表示将误差分解为负部和正部，揭示了Q-learning误差动态中的最大值诱导非对称性，并提供了确定性和随机情况下的有限时间界。
AI.motivation: Q-learning的有限时间误差分析中，以往方法未能区分正负误差的不同动态行为，尤其是正误差通过Bellman最大值运算被选择和传播的特殊机制尚未被充分理解。
AI.method: 将Q-learning误差分解为负部和正部；负部由固定最优策略的线性时不变(LTI)下界系统控制；正部由线性切换系统控制；分析两者收敛速度的差异。
AI.result: 负侧LTI证书的收敛速度不慢于正侧切换证书，且可能产生更快的指数包络；识别出Q-learning误差动态中的最大值诱导非对称性。
AI.conclusion: Q-learning中正误差通过Bellman最大值被选择和传播导致过估计问题，而负误差受最优策略下界约束，两者存在本质不对称性。
idea_en: A sign-separated error decomposition method for Q-learning that separates negative and positive components of the error vector, enabling asymmetric convergence analysis.
A switching-system representation of Q-learning error dynamics that models the error as a linear switching system controlled by the Bellman maximum operator.
A method for identifying max-induced asymmetry in reinforcement learning algorithms, linking positive error selection/propagation to the overestimation phenomenon.
A certificate mechanism using a lower comparison LTI system associated with the optimal policy to bound negative errors in Q-learning.
Finite-time error bounds for constant step-size Q-learning under both deterministic and stochastic settings using sign-separated analysis.
idea_ch: 一种符号分离的Q-learning误差分解方法，将误差向量分离为负分量和正分量，实现非对称收敛分析。
一种基于切换系统的Q-learning误差动态表示方法，将误差建模为由Bellman最大值算子控制的线性切换系统。
一种识别强化学习算法中最大值诱导非对称性的方法，将正误差选择/传播与过估计现象关联。
一种使用与最优策略相关的下界比较LTI系统来约束Q-learning负误差的证书机制。
基于符号分离分析的常数步长Q-learning在确定性和随机设定下的有限时间误差界计算方法。

title: ShopGym: An Integrated Framework for Realistic Simulation and Scalable Benchmarking of E-Commerce Web Agents
summary: Developing and evaluating e-commerce web agents requires environments that preserve meaningful task structure while enabling controllable, reproducible, and scalable scientific comparison. Existing methodologies force a tradeoff: live storefronts provide realism but are non-stationary, difficult to inspect, and irreproducible, while hand-built sandbox benchmarks provide control but cover only a narrow range of layouts, catalogs, policies, and interaction patterns. We argue that the core bottleneck is methodological: the field lacks a scalable way to construct evaluation settings that are simultaneously realistic, diverse, controllable, inspectable, and reproducible. We introduce ShopGym, an integrated framework for realistic simulation and scalable benchmarking of e-commerce web agents. ShopGym is a framework for constructing e-commerce simulation environments and grounded benchmark tasks. Its simulation layer, ShopArena, converts live seed storefronts into self-contained sandbox shops through anonymized shop specifications and a staged, validated generation process. On top of these simulated storefronts, ShopGuru synthesizes benchmark tasks across seven skill categories, grounding each task in the shop's catalog, navigation structure, policies, and interaction affordances. Together, ShopArena and ShopGuru produce self-contained, resettable, inspectable, and stable evaluation artifacts that preserve structural properties and agent-evaluation signals relevant to shopping tasks. We validate the framework through graph-based structural analysis and agent-based behavioral evaluation with 224 generated tasks across six sandbox shops: three constructed with synthetic data and three with real data. Our results show that the synthetic shops preserve key structural properties of live storefronts, with agent performance on synthetic shops positively correlated with performance on live storefronts.

AI.tldr: ShopGym是一个用于电子商务网络代理的现实模拟和可扩展基准测试的集成框架，包含ShopArena（将真实店铺转换为沙盒环境）和ShopGuru（合成基准测试任务），解决了现有方法在真实性与可控性之间的权衡问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的电子商务网络代理评估方法存在两难困境：真实店铺环境具有现实性但不可控、不可复现；手工构建的沙盒基准测试虽可控但覆盖范围有限。核心瓶颈在于缺乏一种可扩展的方法来构建同时具备真实性、多样性、可控性、可检查性和可复现性的评估环境。
AI.method: ShopGym包含两个核心组件：1) ShopArena——通过匿名化店铺规范和分阶段验证的生成过程，将真实种子店铺转换为自包含的沙盒店铺；2) ShopGuru——在模拟店铺基础上，跨七个技能类别合成基准测试任务，每个任务基于店铺的目录、导航结构、政策和交互能力进行设计。
AI.result: 通过图结构分析和基于智能体的行为评估，在224个生成任务、6个沙盒店铺（3个合成数据、3个真实数据）上验证：合成店铺保留了真实店铺的关键结构特性，且智能体在合成店铺上的表现与在真实店铺上的表现呈正相关。
AI.conclusion: ShopGym提供了一种可扩展的方法，能够构建同时具备真实性、可控性、可检查性和可复现性的电子商务评估环境，为电子商务网络代理的研究提供了更科学的评价平台。

A framework for synthesizing grounded benchmark tasks across multiple skill categories based on a shop's catalog, navigation structure, policies, and interaction affordances.
A graph-based structural analysis technique for verifying structural similarity between simulated sandbox shops and live storefronts.
An agent-based behavioral validation method that correlates agent performance between synthetic and real e-commerce environments.
A system for generating reproducible, resettable, and inspectable e-commerce evaluation artifacts that preserve structural properties of real storefronts.

title: Property-Guided LLM Program Synthesis for Planning
summary: LLMs have shown impressive success in program synthesis, discovering programs that surpass prior solutions. However, these approaches rely on simple numeric scores to signal program quality, such as the value of the solution or the number of passed tests. Because a score offers no guidance on why a program failed, the system must generate and evaluate many candidates hoping some succeed, increasing LLM inference and evaluation costs. We study a different approach: property-guided LLM program synthesis. Instead of scoring programs after evaluation, we check whether a candidate satisfies a formally defined property. When the property is violated, we stop the evaluation early and provide the LLM with a concrete counterexample showing exactly how the program failed. This feedback drastically reduces both the number of program generations and the evaluation cost, and can guide the LLM to generate stronger programs. We evaluate this approach on PDDL planning domains, asking the LLM to synthesize direct heuristic functions: every state reachable by strictly improving transitions has a strictly improving successor. A heuristic with this property leads hill-climbing algorithm directly to a goal state. A counterexample-guided repair loop generates one candidate program, checks the property over a training set, and returns the first case that violates the property. We evaluate our approach on ten planning domains with an out-of-distribution test set. The synthesized heuristics are effectively direct on virtually all test tasks, and compared to the best prior generation method our approach generates seven times fewer programs per domain on average, solves more tasks without using search, and requires several orders of magnitude less computation to evaluate candidates. Whenever a problem admits a verifiable property, property-guided LLM synthesis can reduce cost and improve program quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出属性引导的LLM程序合成方法，通过形式化属性验证和反例反馈机制，在PDDL规划领域合成直接启发式函数，相比传统评分方法减少了7倍的程序生成量，降低了数个数量级的计算成本。
AI.motivation: 传统LLM程序合成依赖简单数值评分（如解的值或通过的测试数），评分无法解释程序失败原因，导致系统需要生成并评估大量候选程序，增加了LLM推理和评估成本。
AI.method: 属性引导的LLM程序合成：对候选程序检查形式化定义的属性，违反时提前终止评估并向LLM提供具体反例；采用反例引导修复循环，每次生成一个候选程序，在训练集上检查属性，返回第一个违反属性的案例。
AI.result: 在10个规划领域上的实验表明，合成的启发式在几乎所有测试任务上有效；相比最佳现有方法，平均每个领域减少7倍程序生成量，无需搜索即可解决更多任务，评估候选程序所需的计算量降低数个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 当问题存在可验证属性时，属性引导的LLM合成可以降低成本和提升程序质量。
idea_en: A property-guided LLM program synthesis method with counterexample-guided repair loop, where a formal property is checked on candidate programs and concrete counterexamples are fed back to the LLM when violation occurs.
An early termination mechanism for program evaluation based on formal property violation detection, stopping evaluation immediately upon counterexample discovery.

A direct heuristic function synthesis method for PDDL planning domains where every state reachable by strictly improving transitions has a strictly improving successor, verified through formal property checking.
An out-of-distribution testing framework for synthesized heuristics in planning domains, validating generalization capability beyond training distributions.
idea_ch: 一种属性引导的LLM程序合成方法及反例引导修复循环：通过检查候选程序是否满足形式化定义的属性，在违反时提供具体反例作为反馈，指导LLM生成更优程序。
一种基于形式化属性违反检测的程序评估提前终止机制：在评估过程中一旦发现反例立即停止，大幅降低评估计算成本。
一种面向PDDL规划领域的直接启发式函数合成方法：通过属性验证确保每个由严格改进转移可达的状态都存在严格改进后继状态，使爬山算法直接导向目标状态。
一种规划领域中合成启发式函数的分布外测试框架：验证合成启发式在训练分布之外任务上的泛化能力。

title: Look Before You Leap: Autonomous Exploration for LLM Agents
summary: Large language model based agents often fail in unfamiliar environments due to premature exploitation: a tendency to act on prior knowledge before acquiring sufficient environment-specific information. We identify autonomous exploration as a critical yet underexplored capability for building adaptive agents. To formalize and quantify this capability, we introduce Exploration Checkpoint Coverage, a verifiable metric that measures how broadly an agent discovers key states, objects, and affordances. Our systematic evaluation reveals that agents trained with standard task-oriented reinforcement learning consistently exhibit narrow and repetitive behaviors that impede downstream performance. To address this limitation, we develop a training strategy that interleaves task-execution rollouts and exploration rollouts, with each type of rollout optimized by its corresponding verifiable reward. Building on this training strategy, we propose the Explore-then-Act paradigm, which decouples information-gathering from task execution: agents first utilize an interaction budget to acquire grounded environmental knowledge, then leverage it for task resolution. Our results demonstrate that learning to systematically explore is imperative for building generalizable and real-world-ready agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出探索-执行范式，通过解耦信息收集与任务执行，解决大语言模型智能体在陌生环境中的过早利用问题，并引入探索检查点覆盖率作为可验证的探索能力度量指标。
AI.motivation: 基于大语言模型的智能体在陌生环境中常因过早利用先验知识而失败，缺乏在环境中系统性地收集信息的探索能力，这限制了智能体的自适应能力和泛化性。
AI.method: 提出探索检查点覆盖率（Exploration Checkpoint Coverage）作为可验证度量指标；设计交错执行任务rollout和探索rollout的训练策略，每种rollout由对应的可验证奖励优化；构建探索-执行范式，先利用交互预算获取环境知识，再用于任务解决。
AI.result: 实验表明标准任务导向强化学习训练的智能体表现出狭窄重复的行为，而提出的探索训练策略显著提升下游任务性能，系统性探索对构建可泛化的智能体至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 学习系统性地探索是构建可泛化、真实世界智能体的必要条件，探索-执行范式为自适应智能体提供了有效框架。
idea_en: Exploration Checkpoint Coverage (ECC): A verifiable metric for measuring how broadly an agent discovers key states, objects, and affordances in an environment, enabling quantitative evaluation of exploration capability.

Interleaved Training Strategy: A method that alternates between task-execution rollouts and exploration rollouts, each optimized by its corresponding verifiable reward, to train agents that can systematically gather environmental information.

Explore-then-Act Paradigm: A decoupled framework where agents first use an interaction budget to acquire grounded environmental knowledge through exploration, then leverage that knowledge for task execution, preventing premature exploitation of prior knowledge.
idea_ch: 探索检查点覆盖率（ECC）：一种可验证的度量指标，用于衡量智能体在环境中发现关键状态、物体和功能属性的广度，实现对探索能力的定量评估。
交错训练策略：一种在任务执行rollout和探索rollout之间交替的训练方法，每种rollout由对应的可验证奖励优化，用于训练能够系统性收集环境信息的智能体。
探索-执行范式：一种解耦框架，智能体首先利用交互预算通过探索获取基于环境的具体知识，然后利用这些知识执行任务，从而防止对先验知识的过早利用。

title: An Algebraic Exposition of the Theory of Dyadic Morality
summary: This paper provides an algebraic exposition of the theory of dyadic morality (TDM), a psychological model of moral judgment grounded in a simple two-node template: an intentional agent causing harm to a vulnerable patient. We formalize TDM using structural causal modeling (SCM) notation and identify three psychological operators (typecasting operator, completion operator, and valence-dependent inference mechanism) that extend standard SCM to capture how people compute moral judgments under constraints. We address scalability challenges arising from TDM's dyadic limitation, showing how moral cognition compresses multi-node scenarios through node collapse and sequential processing. Drawing on this algebraic framework, we demonstrate concrete applications to AI policy design: detecting conflicting obligations, structuring helpfulness policies to preserve user agency, and designing post-failure communication as causal interventions. Finally, we recommend scoped, contextual measurement of mind perception over universal averaging to operationalize the theory empirically. This algebraic formalization enables neurosymbolic AI systems to compute morality in a way that is both mathematically rigorous and faithful to human moral cognition.

AI.tldr: 本文提出二元道德理论的代数形式化框架，运用结构因果模型（SCM）将其核心模板（意图施害者→受害脆弱者）及三种心理算子形式化，并通过节点压缩和顺序处理解决可扩展性问题，最终应用于AI政策设计。
AI.motivation: 现有二元道德理论缺乏数学形式化基础，难以在AI系统中实现可计算、可验证的道德判断。需要将心理学模型转化为严谨的代数框架，以支持神经符号AI系统的道德推理。
AI.method: 使用结构因果模型（SCM）符号形式化TDM的二元模板；定义三种心理算子：定型化算子、完成算子、效价依赖推理机制；提出节点压缩和顺序处理两种扩展机制；将形式化框架应用于AI政策冲突检测、助人策略设计、失效后沟通等场景。
AI.result: 成功将二元道德理论转化为代数形式化框架，解决了其可扩展性问题，并在AI政策设计（冲突义务检测、用户自主权保护、失效后因果干预沟通）等场景展示了具体应用。
AI.conclusion: 代数形式化为神经符号AI系统提供了数学严谨且符合人类道德认知的计算方法，建议采用有范围、情境化的心智感知测量而非通用平均化来经验操作化该理论。
idea_en: A structural causal modeling (SCM) based method for formalizing dyadic morality theory into computable algebraic operators, including typecasting operator, completion operator, and valence-dependent inference mechanism.
A node collapse mechanism that compresses multi-node moral scenarios into the canonical two-node template (agent-patient) for scalability in moral cognition computing.
A sequential processing approach for handling complex multi-agent moral scenarios by decomposing them into sequences of dyadic moral judgments.
A method for detecting conflicting obligations in AI policy design using the formalized dyadic morality framework and causal intervention analysis.
A technique for designing AI helpfulness policies that preserve user agency by structuring them according to the formalized valence-dependent inference mechanism.
A post-failure communication method for AI systems that treats communication as causal interventions within the dyadic morality SCM framework.
A scoped, contextual measurement method for mind perception attribution in AI systems, replacing universal averaging with context-dependent assessment.
idea_ch: 一种基于结构因果模型（SCM）的二元道德理论形式化方法，将道德判断转化为可计算的代数算子，包括定型化算子、完成算子和效价依赖推理机制。

一种顺序处理方法，将复杂多智能体道德场景分解为一系列二元道德判断序列进行处理。
一种利用形式化二元道德框架和因果干预分析检测AI政策设计中冲突义务的方法。
一种根据形式化效价依赖推理机制结构化的AI助人策略设计技术，以保护用户自主权。
一种将AI失效后沟通视为二元道德SCM框架内因果干预的新型通信方法。
一种有范围、情境化的心智感知归属测量方法，替代通用平均化方法以更精确地操作化AI系统中的道德认知理论。

title: Formal Methods Meet LLMs: Auditing, Monitoring, and Intervention for Compliance of Advanced AI Systems
summary: We examine one particular dimension of AI governance: how to monitor and audit AI-enabled products and services throughout the AI development lifecycle, from pre-deployment testing to post-deployment auditing. Combining principles from formal methods with SoTA machine learning, we propose techniques that enable AI-enabled product and service developers, as well as third party AI developers and evaluators, to perform offline auditing and online (runtime) monitoring of product-specific (temporally extended) behavioral constraints such as safety constraints, norms, rules and regulations with respect to black-box advanced AI systems, notably LLMs. We further provide practical techniques for predictive monitoring, such as sampling-based methods, and we introduce intervening monitors that act at runtime to preempt and potentially mitigate predicted violations. Experimental results show that by exploiting the formal syntax and semantics of Linear Temporal Logic (LTL), our proposed auditing and monitoring techniques are superior to LLM baseline methods in detecting violations of temporally extended behavioral constraints; with our approach, even small-model labelers match or exceed frontier LLM judges. Our predictive and intervening monitors significantly reduce the violation rates of LLM-based agents while largely preserving task performance. We further show through controlled experiments that LLMs' temporal reasoning shows a pronounced degradation in accuracy with increasing event distance, number of constraints, and number of propositions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出结合形式化方法与机器学习的技术，实现对AI产品（尤其是LLM）全生命周期的离线审计与在线监控，利用线性时序逻辑（LTL）检测时间扩展行为约束违规，并提出预测性和干预性监控方法，实验表明该方法优于LLM基线，能显著降低违规率。
AI.motivation: 现有AI监管缺乏对时间扩展行为约束（如安全约束、规范、法规）的系统性离线审计和运行时监控方法，尤其是针对黑盒高级AI系统（如LLM）的监控手段不足。
AI.method: 结合形式化方法（线性时序逻辑LTL）与机器学习，提出离线审计与在线（运行时）监控技术；引入基于采样的预测性监控方法；提出运行时干预性监控器，用于预测并提前阻止违规行为。
AI.result: 利用LTL的形式化语法和语义，所提出的审计和监控技术在检测时间扩展行为约束违规方面优于LLM基线方法；小模型标注器达到或超越前沿LLM判断器；预测性和干预性监控器显著降低LLM代理的违规率，同时基本保持任务性能；实验表明LLM的时间推理能力随事件距离、约束数量和命题数量增加而显著下降。
AI.conclusion: 形式化方法（LTL）结合机器学习可有效提升AI系统在时间扩展行为约束方面的审计和监控能力，为AI治理提供了可落地的技术路径。
idea_en: A method for offline auditing of AI systems using Linear Temporal Logic (LTL) to formally specify and detect violations of temporally extended behavioral constraints (safety, norms, regulations) in black-box LLMs.
A runtime monitoring technique for AI-enabled products that combines formal methods with machine learning to continuously check compliance with temporal behavioral constraints during deployment.
A predictive monitoring approach using sampling-based methods to forecast potential violations of temporal constraints in AI agents before they occur.
An intervening monitor mechanism that operates at runtime to preempt and mitigate predicted violations of behavioral constraints in LLM-based agents.
A system that uses small-model labelers as LTL-based constraint verifiers to match or exceed the performance of frontier LLM judges in detecting temporal reasoning violations.
idea_ch: 一种利用线性时序逻辑（LTL）对黑盒LLM进行离线审计的方法，通过形式化语法和语义规定并检测时间扩展行为约束（安全、规范、法规）的违规行为。
一种结合形式化方法与机器学习的AI产品运行时监控技术，在部署阶段持续检查时间行为约束的合规性。
一种基于采样的预测性监控方法，在AI代理违规发生前预测时间约束的潜在违规。
一种运行时干预监控器机制，用于在预测到违规时主动预防和缓解LLM代理的行为约束违规。
一种使用小模型标注器作为LTL约束验证器的系统，在检测时间推理违规方面达到或超越前沿LLM判断器的性能。

title: Context, Reasoning, and Hierarchy: A Cost-Performance Study of Compound LLM Agent Design in an Adversarial POMDP
summary: Deploying compound LLM agents in adversarial, partially observable sequential environments requires navigating several design dimensions: (1) what the agent sees, (2) how it reasons, and (3) how tasks are decomposed across components. Yet practitioners lack guidance on which design choices improve performance versus merely increase inference costs. We present a controlled study of compound LLM agent design in CybORG CAGE-2, a cyber defense environment modeled as a Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP). Reward is non-positive, so all configurations operate in a failure-mitigation mode. Our evaluation spans five model families, six models, and twelve configurations (3,475 episodes) with token-level cost accounting. We vary context representation (raw observations vs. a deterministic state-tracking layer with compressed history), deliberation (self-questioning, self-critique, and self-improvement tools, with optional chain-of-thought prompting), and hierarchical decomposition (monolithic ReAct vs. delegation to specialized sub-agents). We find that: (1) Programmatic state abstraction delivers the largest returns per token spent (RPTS), improving mean return by up to 76% over raw observations. (2) Distributing deliberation tools across a hierarchy degrades performance relative to hierarchy alone for all five model families, reaching up to 3.4$\times$ worse mean return while using 1.8-2.7$\times$ more tokens. We call this destructive pattern a deliberation cascade. (3) Hierarchical decomposition without deliberation achieves the best absolute performance for most models, and context engineering is generally more cost-effective than deliberation. These findings suggest a design principle for structured adversarial POMDPs: invest in programmatic infrastructure and clean task decomposition rather than deeper per-agent reasoning, as these strategies can interfere when combined.

AI.tldr: 本文通过CybORG CAGE-2网络防御环境，系统研究了复合LLM智能体在对抗性部分可观测环境中的设计选择，发现编程式状态抽象和层次化分解比推理工具更高效，且将推理工具分布在层次结构中会导致性能严重下降（"推理级联"）。
AI.motivation: 部署复合LLM智能体在对抗性、部分可观测的序贯环境中需要权衡多项设计维度，但从业者缺乏指导，不清楚哪些设计选择能真正提升性能而非仅仅增加推理成本。
AI.method: 在CybORG CAGE-2（一个POMDP网络防御环境）中进行控制实验，涵盖5个模型家族、6个模型和12种配置（3,475个回合），进行token级成本核算。变化上下文表示（原始观测 vs. 确定性状态追踪层）、推理方式（自问、自批判、自改进工具，可选思维链提示）和层次化分解（单体ReAct vs. 委派给专业子智能体）。
AI.result: (1) 编程式状态抽象在每token回报上表现最佳，相比原始观测提升76%。(2) 将推理工具分布在层次结构中会导致性能下降（高达3.4倍更差），同时消耗1.8-2.7倍更多token，称为"推理级联"。(3) 无推理的层次化分解在大多数模型上取得最佳绝对性能，上下文工程通常比推理更具成本效益。
AI.conclusion: 对于结构化对抗性POMDP，设计原则是：投资于编程式基础设施和清晰的任务分解，而非强化单智能体推理，因为后者在组合时可能相互干扰。
idea_en: A programmatic state abstraction layer that compresses historical observations into deterministic state representations for compound LLM agents in adversarial POMDPs, improving return per token by up to 76%.
A hierarchical task decomposition architecture for LLM agents in cyber defense environments, where specialized sub-agents handle distinct responsibilities without per-agent deliberation tools.

A deliberation cascade detection method that identifies when distributing self-questioning, self-critique, and self-improvement tools across hierarchical LLM agents degrades performance and increases token consumption.
A cost-accounted evaluation framework for compound LLM agent designs that measures return per token spent (RPTS) to distinguish performance improvements from mere inference cost increases.
idea_ch: 一种用于对抗性POMDP中复合LLM智能体的编程式状态抽象层，将历史观测压缩为确定性状态表示，每token回报提升高达76%。
一种用于网络防御环境的LLM智能体层次化任务分解架构，专业子智能体负责不同职责，无需在每个子智能体上配备推理工具。
一种推理级联检测方法，用于识别在层次化LLM智能体中分布自问、自批判和自改进工具时，导致性能下降和token消耗增加的现象。
一种复合LLM智能体设计的成本核算评估框架，通过测量每token回报（RPTS）来区分真实的性能提升与单纯的推理成本增加。

title: Confirming Correct, Missing the Rest: LLM Tutoring Agents Struggle Where Feedback Matters Most
summary: Effective tutoring requires distinguishing optimal, valid but suboptimal, and incorrect student solutions, a distinction central to intelligent tutoring systems (ITS) but untested for LLM-based tutors. As LLMs are increasingly explored as conversational complements to ITS, evaluating their diagnostic precision is essential. We present a benchmark of seven LLM feedback agents in propositional logic using knowledge-graph-derived ground truth across 10,836 solution--feedback pairs and three feedback conditions. Models achieved near-ceiling performance on optimal steps but systematically over-rejected valid but suboptimal reasoning and over-validated incorrect solutions, precisely where adaptive tutoring matters most. These failures persisted across models regardless of solution context, suggesting architectural rather than informational limits. Moreover, accurate diagnosis did not reliably produce pedagogically actionable feedback, revealing a gap between diagnostic judgment and instructional effectiveness. Our findings suggest that LLMs are better suited for hybrid architectures where KG-grounded models handle diagnosis while LLMs support open-ended scaffolding and dialogue.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了7种基于LLM的反馈代理在命题逻辑推理中的诊断能力，发现它们在最优步骤上表现良好，但在区分有效但次优推理与错误推理时系统性失败，且准确诊断不等于有效教学反馈。
AI.motivation: 虽然LLM被探索作为智能 tutoring 系统的对话补充，但其能否准确区分不同质量级别的学生解决方案（最优、有效但次优、错误）尚未被系统测试。
AI.method: 构建了一个包含10,836个解决方案-反馈对的标准基准，利用知识图谱（KG）生成的ground truth，在三种反馈条件下评估7种LLM反馈代理在命题逻辑中的诊断精度。
AI.result: 模型在最优步骤上达到接近天花板性能，但系统性地过度拒绝有效但次优的推理，并过度验证错误解决方案。这些问题在所有模型中持续存在，且准确诊断不等于有效的教学反馈。
AI.conclusion: LLM更适合混合架构：KG基础模型负责诊断，LLM负责开放式的脚手架和对话支持。
idea_en: A hybrid intelligent tutoring system architecture where knowledge graph models perform solution diagnosis and LLMs handle open-ended scaffolding and dialogue.
A method for generating ground-truth student solution quality labels using knowledge graphs for propositional logic tutoring.
A feedback generation system that separates diagnostic judgment (KG-based) from instructional feedback generation (LLM-based) to improve pedagogical effectiveness.
idea_ch: 一种混合智能辅导系统架构，由知识图谱模型负责学生解决方案诊断，LLM负责开放式脚手架和对话生成。
一种利用知识图谱为命题逻辑辅导生成学生解决方案质量真实标签的方法。
一种将诊断判断（基于知识图谱）与教学反馈生成（基于LLM）分离的反馈生成系统，以提高教学有效性。

title: Fully Open Meditron: An Auditable Pipeline for Clinical LLMs
comment: Preprint. 31 pages, 10 figures. Code, models, and data: https://github.com/EPFLiGHT/FullyOpenMeditron
summary: Clinical decision support systems (CDSS) require scrutable, auditable pipelines that enable rigorous, reproducible validation. Yet current LLM-based CDSS remain largely opaque. Most "open" models are open-weight only, releasing parameters while withholding the data provenance, curation procedures, and generation pipelines that determine model behavior. Fully Open (FO) models, which expose the complete training stack end-to-end, do not currently exist in medicine. We introduce Fully Open Meditron, the first fully open pipeline for building LLM-CDSS, comprising a clinician-audited training corpus, a reproducible data construction and training framework, and a use-aligned evaluation protocol. The corpus unifies eight public medical QA datasets into a normalized conversational format and expands coverage with three clinician-vetted synthetic extensions: exam-style QA, guideline-grounded QA derived from 46,469 clinical practice guidelines, and clinical vignettes. The pipeline enforces system-wide decontamination, gold-label resampling of teacher generations, and end-to-end validation by a four-physician panel. We evaluate using an LLM-as-a-judge protocol over expert-written clinical vignettes, calibrated against 204 human raters. We apply the recipe to five FO base models (Apertus-70B/8B-Instruct, OLMo-2-32B-SFT, EuroLLM-22B/9B-Instruct). All MeditronFO variants are preferred over their bases. Apertus-70B-MeditronFO improves +6.6 points over its base (47.2% to 53.8%) on aggregate medical benchmarks, establishing a new FO SoTA. Gemma-3-27B-MeditronFO is preferred over MedGemma in 58.6% of LLM-as-a-judge comparisons and outperforms it on HealthBench (58% vs 55.9%). These results show that fully open pipelines can achieve state-of-the-art domain-specific performance without sacrificing auditability or reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Fully Open Meditron，首个完全开放的临床决策支持系统（CDSS）构建pipeline，涵盖由临床医生审核的训练语料库、可复现的数据构建和训练框架，以及对齐使用场景的评估协议。该pipeline在五个完全开源基座模型上应用，所有MeditronFO变体均优于基座，Apertus-70B-MeditronFO在医学基准上提升6.6个百分点，达到新的完全开源SOTA。
AI.motivation: 当前基于LLM的CDSS大多不透明，所谓"开源"模型往往只开放权重，而隐瞒数据来源、整理流程和生成pipeline等决定模型行为的关键信息。医学领域尚不存在完全开放（Fully Open）的模型，这严重阻碍了CDSS的可审查性、可审计性和可复现验证。
AI.method: 1) 构建临床医生审核的训练语料库：统一8个公开医学QA数据集为标准对话格式，加上三个临床医生验证的合成扩展（考试式QA、基于46,469条临床指南的QA、临床小病例）；2) 建立可复现的数据构建和训练框架：系统级去污染、教师生成的金标签重采样、四位医生终审验证；3) 设计对齐使用场景的评估协议：LLM-as-a-judge结合专家撰写的临床小病例，经204名人类评价者校准；4) 在五个完全开源基座模型上应用该pipeline。
AI.result: 所有MeditronFO变体均优于各自基座模型。Apertus-70B-MeditronFO在综合医学基准上提升6.6个百分点（从47.2%到53.8%），创造完全开源模型新SOTA。Gemma-3-27B-MeditronFO在58.6%的LLM-as-a-judge对比中优于MedGemma，且在HealthBench上以58%超越后者（55.9%）。
AI.conclusion: 完全开放的pipeline可以在不牺牲可审计性和可复现性的前提下，实现领域特定的SOTA性能。这证明透明、可审计的LLM-CDSS构建方法是可行且有效的，为临床决策支持系统的可信部署提供了新范式。
idea_en: 1. Fully open pipeline for building LLM-based clinical decision support systems that exposes complete training stack end-to-end, including data provenance, curation procedures, and generation pipelines, enabling rigorous auditability and reproducibility.

2. Clinician-audited training corpus unifying eight public medical QA datasets into a normalized conversational format, combined with three clinician-vetted synthetic extensions (exam-style QA, guideline-grounded QA from 46,469 clinical practice guidelines, and clinical vignettes).
3. System-wide decontamination method ensuring training and evaluation data separation in medical LLM development.
4. Gold-label resampling of teacher generations technique for improving quality of synthetic training data in medical domain.
5. LLM-as-a-judge evaluation protocol for clinical vignettes calibrated against 204 human raters, providing a scalable and validated alternative to human evaluation for medical QA systems.
6. Four-physician end-to-end validation panel methodology for ensuring clinical accuracy and safety of LLM-generated medical content.
7. Reproducible data construction and training framework that enables any fully open base model to achieve state-of-the-art medical performance through the disclosed pipeline.
idea_ch: 1. 完全开放的LLM临床决策支持系统（CDSS）构建pipeline，端到端暴露完整训练堆栈，包括数据来源、整理流程和生成pipeline，实现严格的可审计性和可复现性。
2. 临床医生审核的训练语料库，将8个公开医学QA数据集统一为标准对话格式，结合三种临床医生验证的合成扩展数据（考试式QA、基于46,469条临床实践指南的问答、临床小病例）。
3. 系统级去污染方法，确保医学LLM开发中训练数据和评估数据的严格分离。
4. 教师生成的金标签重采样技术，用于提升医学领域合成训练数据的质量。
5. 基于LLM-as-a-judge的临床小病例评估协议，经204名人类评价者校准，为医学QA系统提供可扩展且经过验证的替代人类评估方案。
6. 四位医生终审验证panel方法，确保LLM生成的医学内容的临床准确性和安全性。
7. 可复现的数据构建和训练框架，使得任何完全开源基座模型能够通过该公开pipeline达到医学领域SOTA性能。

title: FORGE: Self-Evolving Agent Memory With No Weight Updates via Population Broadcast
summary: Can LLM agents improve decision-making through self-generated memory without gradient updates? We propose FORGE (Failure-Optimized Reflective Graduation and Evolution), a staged, population-based protocol that evolves prompt-injected natural-language memory for hierarchical ReAct agents. FORGE wraps a Reflexion-style inner loop, where a dedicated reflection agent (using the same underlying LLM, no distillation from a stronger model) converts failed trajectories into reusable knowledge artifacts: textual heuristics (Rules), few-shot demonstrations (Examples), or both (Mixed), with an outer loop that propagates the best-performing instance's memory to the population between stages and freezes converged instances via a graduation criterion. We evaluate on CybORG CAGE-2, a stochastic network-defense POMDP at a 30-step horizon against the B-line attacker, where all four tested LLM families (Gemini-2.5-Flash-Lite, Grok-4-Fast, Llama-4-Maverick, Qwen3-235B) exhibit strongly negative, heavy-tailed zero-shot rewards. Compared against both a zero-shot baseline and a Reflexion baseline (isolated single-stream learning), FORGE improves average evaluation return by 1.7-7.7$\times$ over zero-shot and by 29-72% over Reflexion in all 12 model-representation conditions, reducing major-failure rates (below $-100$) to as low as $\sim$1%. We find that (1) population broadcast is critical mechanism, with a no-graduation ablation confirming that broadcast carries the performance gains while graduation primarily saves compute; (2) Examples achieves the strongest returns for three of four models, Rules offers the best cost-reliability profile with $\sim$40% fewer tokens; and (3) weaker baseline models benefit disproportionately, suggesting FORGE may mitigate capability gaps rather than amplify strong models. All evidence is confined to CAGE-2 B-line; cross-family findings are directional evidence.

AI.tldr: FORGE是一种无需梯度更新的、基于种群的记忆演化协议，通过层次化ReAct代理的文本记忆迭代优化，在CybORG CAGE-2网络防御任务中将平均回报提升1.7-7.7倍，并将严重失败率降至约1%。
AI.motivation: 探索LLM代理能否通过自我生成的记忆（而非梯度更新）来改进决策，解决零样本设置下强负回报和大量失败轨迹的问题。
AI.method: 提出FORGE协议：内层为Reflexion式循环，用专用反思代理（同模型，无蒸馏）将失败轨迹转化为三类知识 artifact（文本规则Rules、少样本示例Examples、混合Mixed）；外层在阶段间广播最优实例记忆，并通过毕业标准冻结收敛实例。
AI.result: 在4个LLM家族、12种模型-表征条件下，FORGE平均回报比零样本提升1.7-7.7倍，比Reflexion提升29-72%；严重失败率降至约1%。广播机制是性能关键，毕业机制主要用于节省计算；Examples获得最强回报，Rules在成本-可靠性上最优；弱模型受益更大。
AI.conclusion: FORGE有效证明了无需梯度更新、仅凭种群级文本记忆演化即可显著提升LLM代理决策质量，尤其在弱势模型上效果显著，但证据局限于CAGE-2 B-line环境。
idea_en: A population-based memory evolution protocol for hierarchical ReAct agents that iteratively refines prompt-injected natural-language memory without gradient updates, using an inner Reflexion-style loop and an outer population broadcast loop.

A method of converting failed trajectories into reusable knowledge artifacts categorized as textual heuristics (Rules), few-shot demonstrations (Examples), or their combination (Mixed) by a dedicated reflection agent using the same underlying LLM.
A graduation criterion mechanism that freezes converged instances in the population to save computational resources while preserving performance gains.
A population broadcast mechanism that propagates the best-performing instance's memory to the entire population between stages, shown to be the critical mechanism driving performance improvements.

A staged evolution protocol that enables weaker baseline models to disproportionately benefit from population-based memory sharing, effectively mitigating capability gaps without requiring stronger models or gradient updates.
idea_ch: 一种无需梯度更新的、基于种群的记忆演化协议，用于层次化ReAct代理，通过内层Reflexion式循环和外层种群广播循环，迭代优化提示注入的自然语言记忆。
一种将失败轨迹转化为可复用知识制品的方法，由专用反思代理（使用相同LLM，无蒸馏）将其分类为文本启发式规则（Rules）、少样本示例（Examples）或两者混合（Mixed）。
一种毕业标准机制，用于冻结种群中已收敛的实例，在保持性能的同时节省计算资源。
一种种群广播机制，在阶段间将最优表现实例的记忆传播到整个种群，实验证明这是驱动性能提升的关键机制。
一种分阶段演化协议，使弱势基础模型能够从种群级记忆共享中获得不成比例的受益，在不依赖更强模型或梯度更新的情况下有效缩小能力差距。

title: Prospective multi-pathogen disease forecasting using autonomous LLM-guided tree search
summary: Probabilistic forecasting of infectious diseases is crucial for public health but relies on labor-intensive manual model curation by expert modeling teams. This bespoke development bottlenecks scalability to granular geographic resolutions or emerging pathogens. Here, we present an autonomous system using Large Language Model (LLM)-guided tree search to iteratively generate, evaluate, and optimize executable forecasting software. In a fully prospective, real-time evaluation during the 2025-2026 US respiratory season, the system autonomously discovered methodologically diverse models for influenza, COVID-19, and respiratory syncytial virus (RSV). Aggregating these machine-generated models yielded an ensemble that consistently matched or outperformed the gold-standard, human-curated Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) hub ensembles out-of-sample. The system successfully navigated data-scarce "cold start" scenarios for RSV. Moreover, controlled retrospective ablations revealed that optimizing log-scale distance metrics prevents reward hacking, while an automated judge-in-the-loop ensures structural fidelity to complex scientific theories. By autonomously translating epidemiological theory into accurate, transparent code, this framework overcomes the modeling labor bottleneck, enabling rapid deployment of expert-level disease forecasting at unprecedented scales.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于大语言模型(LLM)引导的树搜索自主系统，能够自动生成、评估和优化传染病概率预测软件。在2025-2026年美国呼吸季节的前瞻性实时评估中，该系统自动发现的方法多样性模型集合在性能上匹配或超越了CDC人工策划的黄金标准集成模型。
AI.motivation: 传染病概率预测对公共卫生至关重要，但传统上依赖专家团队耗时费力的人工模型策划，这种定制开发模式在扩展到细粒度地理分辨率或新兴病原体时存在严重的规模化瓶颈。
AI.method: 使用LLM引导的树搜索算法，迭代生成、评估和优化可执行的预测软件。系统通过优化对数尺度距离指标防止奖励黑客行为，并采用自动化的裁判机制确保对复杂科学理论的结构保真度。
AI.result: 在2025-2026年美国呼吸季节的前瞻性实时评估中，系统自主生成的流感、COVID-19和RSV预测模型集成在性能上一致匹配或超越了CDC人工策划的黄金标准集成。系统成功应对了RSV数据稀缺的"冷启动"场景。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过自主将流行病学理论转化为准确、透明的代码，克服了建模劳动力瓶颈，实现了前所未有的规模下快速部署专家级疾病预测。

Autonomous ensemble aggregation of machine-generated infectious disease models that matches or outperforms human-curated expert ensembles
Log-scale distance metric optimization to prevent reward hacking in automated model generation
Automated judge-in-the-loop mechanism ensuring structural fidelity to complex scientific theories in LLM-generated code
Cold-start handling system for data-scarce emerging pathogens using LLM-guided tree search
Autonomous translation of epidemiological theory into accurate, transparent executable code without manual intervention

机器生成传染病模型的自主集成聚合方法，性能匹配或超越人工专家集成模型

面向数据稀缺新兴病原体的冷启动处理方法，利用LLM引导树搜索
